"""
A website of the run read over plain HTTP (AGENT_HTTP=1): sign-in, pages as text, forms, paging.

The websites render on the server, so a GET returns what a tab would show (http_read.html_view turns it into text)
in about 0.1 to 0.3 s. The sandbox reaches the websites only through HTTP(S)_PROXY; httpx honours it (trust_env).

Generic helpers only, as in the browser path: signing in with the run's credentials, accepting the minimal cookie
choice, retrying a flaky error page, signing in again when the session ends, putting same-site frames in place and
following a list's next-page links when a model asked for that list. Which pages are read, which searches are made
and which forms are sent (e.g. an entry check that asks for a number shown on the page) is the model's choice
(http_nav.py).
"""
import asyncio
import os
import re
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from urllib.parse import urlencode, urljoin, urlparse, urlunparse, parse_qsl

import httpx2

from http_read import Form, html_view

USER_AGENT = "error404ai-rfq-agent/2 (+http)"
FETCH_SECONDS = float(os.environ.get("HTTP_FETCH_SECONDS", "12"))  # one request; a stalled one is tried again
TRIES = 3  # an error page or a stalled request is tried this often
FRAME_DEPTH = 2
MAX_PAGES = 25  # list pages followed per collect()
PARALLEL = int(os.environ.get("HTTP_PARALLEL", "8"))  # requests at once per website

ERROR_PAGE = re.compile(r"vorübergehend nicht verfügbar|temporarily unavailable|service unavailable|bad gateway|"
                        r"gateway time-?out|internal server error|bitte versuchen sie es (später )?erneut",
                        re.IGNORECASE)
COOKIE = re.compile(r"cookie", re.IGNORECASE)
COOKIE_MINIMAL = re.compile(r"notwendig|erforderlich|necessary|essential|nur technisch|ablehnen|reject|decline",
                            re.IGNORECASE)
COOKIE_ANSWER = re.compile(r"akzeptier|accept|zustimm|agree|erlaub|allow|bestätig|confirm|ok\b", re.IGNORECASE)
LOGOUT = re.compile(r"log-?out|sign-?out|log off|abmeld", re.IGNORECASE)
NEXT = re.compile(r"^\s*(weiter|mehr|nächste|naechste|next|more|load more|show more|weitere|folgende|vorwärts|"
                  r"vorwaerts|›|»|>|→)", re.IGNORECASE)
NOT_NEXT = re.compile(r"zurück|zurueck|vorherige|previous|prev|back|erste|first|letzte|last", re.IGNORECASE)
LINK = re.compile(r'\[link "([^"]*)" -> (\S+?)\]')
TARGET_BUTTON = re.compile(r'\[button "([^"]*)"[^\]]*? -> (\S+?)\]')
FRAME = re.compile(r"\[frame (\S+?)\]")


@dataclass
class Page:
    url: str  # where the request ended
    title: str
    text: str  # the view, frames in place
    forms: list[Form] = field(default_factory=list)
    status: int = 200
    seconds: float = 0.0
    asked: str = ""  # the address requested

    def targets(self) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
        """(text, target) of every link, target-carrying button and frame on the page."""
        out = [(t, h) for t, h in LINK.findall(self.text)] + [(t, h) for t, h in TARGET_BUTTON.findall(self.text)]
        out += [("frame", h) for h in FRAME.findall(self.text)]
        return out

    def view(self) -> str:
        return f"URL: {self.url}\nTitle: {self.title}\n\n{self.text}"


def _same(a: str, b: str) -> bool:
    pa, pb = urlparse(a), urlparse(b)
    return pa.path.rstrip("/") == pb.path.rstrip("/") and sorted(parse_qsl(pa.query)) == sorted(parse_qsl(pb.query))


class HttpSite:
    """One website: a cookie session of its own, the pages read so far, and what the readers may quote (seen)."""

    def __init__(self, site: dict, trace, tag: str = ""):
        self.site, self.trace = site, trace
        self.name = site["siteId"] + (f":{tag}" if tag else "")
        self.base = site["url"].rstrip("/") + "/"
        self.host = urlparse(self.base).netloc
        self.client = httpx2.AsyncClient(follow_redirects=True, timeout=FETCH_SECONDS, trust_env=True,
                                         headers={"User-Agent": USER_AGENT, "Accept": "text/html,*/*"})
        self.limit = asyncio.Semaphore(PARALLEL)
        self.pages: dict[str, Page] = {}  # by requested and by final address
        self.seen = ""  # every page text read, for grounding checks
        self.view = ""  # the latest page's text (what helpers written for tabs look at)
        self.logins = 0
        self.login_lock = asyncio.Lock()
        self.relogin_lock = asyncio.Lock()
        self.ok = False
        self.home: Page | None = None
        self.requests = 0
        self.request_seconds = 0.0

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ requests

    def url(self, target: str, base: str | None = None) -> str:
        return urljoin(base or self.base, target.strip())

    def on_site(self, url: str) -> bool:
        return urlparse(url).netloc == self.host

    async def _request(self, method: str, url: str, data=None):
        last = None
        for attempt in range(TRIES):
            began = time.monotonic()
            try:
                async with self.limit:
                    if method == "GET":
                        response = await self.client.get(url)
                    else:
                        response = await self.client.post(  # a list keeps repeated names (checkbox groups)
                            url, content=urlencode(data or []).encode(),
                            headers={"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"})
            except Exception as error:  # a stalled or refused request: once more
                last = error
                self.trace.event(self.name, "http_retry", url=url[:120], error=f"{type(error).__name__}")
                await asyncio.sleep(0.3 * (attempt + 1))
                continue
            finally:
                self.requests += 1
                self.request_seconds += time.monotonic() - began
            flaky = response.status_code >= 500 or (len(response.text) < 30000 and ERROR_PAGE.search(response.text))
            if flaky and attempt + 1 < TRIES:
                await asyncio.sleep(0.4 * (attempt + 1))
                if method != "GET":  # a post that landed on an error page: read where it went instead
                    method, url, data = "GET", str(response.url), None
                continue
            return response
        raise ConnectionError(f"{method} {url} failed: {type(last).__name__ if last else 'error page'}")

    def _signin(self, page: Page) -> Form | None:
        for form in page.forms:
            if any(f.kind == "password" for f in form.fields):
                return form
        return None

    async def _page(self, response, asked: str, depth: int = 0) -> Page:
        final = str(response.url)
        if "html" not in response.headers.get("content-type", "html"):
            text = response.text[:60000]
            return Page(final, "", text, [], response.status_code, asked=asked)
        view = html_view(response.text)
        text = view.text
        if depth < FRAME_DEPTH and view.frames:
            subs = await asyncio.gather(*(self._frame(self.url(src, final), depth) for src in view.frames))
            for i, sub in enumerate(subs):
                text = text.replace(f"\x00FRAME{i}\x00", sub)
        text = re.sub(r"\x00FRAME\d+\x00", "", text)
        return Page(final, view.title, re.sub(r"\n{2,}", "\n", text), view.forms, response.status_code, asked=asked)

    async def _frame(self, url: str, depth: int) -> str:
        if not url.startswith("http") or not self.on_site(url):
            return "(separate)"
        cached = self.pages.get(url)
        if cached is not None:
            return cached.text
        try:
            response = await self._request("GET", url)
            page = await self._page(response, url, depth + 1)
        except Exception as error:
            return f"(not read: {type(error).__name__})"
        return page.text

    def _keep(self, page: Page) -> Page:
        self.pages[page.asked or page.url] = page
        self.pages.setdefault(page.url, page)
        self.seen += "\n" + page.text
        self.view = page.text
        self.trace.event(self.name, "view", quiet=True, url=page.url, text=page.text, http=True)
        return page

    async def get(self, target: str, base: str | None = None, fresh: bool = False) -> Page:
        """The page at a target (relative to `base` or the site), signed in again if the session ended."""
        url = self.url(target, base)
        if not fresh and url in self.pages:
            return self.pages[url]
        began = time.monotonic()
        logins = self.logins
        response = await self._request("GET", url)
        page = await self._page(response, url)
        if self.ok and self._signin(page) is not None:
            # the session ended: sign in again (once, however many requests noticed it) and ask again
            await self.relogin(logins)
            response = await self._request("GET", url)
            page = await self._page(response, url)
        page.seconds = round(time.monotonic() - began, 2)
        self.trace.event(self.name, "http_get", url=url[len(self.base) - 1:][:140] if url.startswith(self.base) else url[:140],
                         landed=page.url[len(self.base) - 1:][:80] if not _same(url, page.url) else "",
                         status=page.status, seconds=page.seconds, chars=len(page.text))
        return self._keep(page)

    async def submit(self, page: Page, number: int, values: dict[str, str], button: str = "") -> Page:
        """Send form `number` (1-based, as the page text numbers it) of `page` with the given field values."""
        form = page.forms[number - 1]
        data = form.data(values, button)
        action = self.url(form.action or page.url, page.url)
        began = time.monotonic()
        if form.method == "get":
            parsed = urlparse(action)
            url = urlunparse(parsed._replace(query=urlencode(data)))
            return await self.get(url, fresh=True)
        logins = self.logins
        response = await self._request("POST", action, data=data)
        result = await self._page(response, action)
        if self.ok and self._signin(result) is not None:
            # the session had ended: signed in again, the model gets the page the site now shows (it may have to
            # send the form again from that page)
            await self.relogin(logins)
            response = await self._request("GET", page.url)
            result = await self._page(response, page.url)
        result.seconds = round(time.monotonic() - began, 2)
        self.trace.event(self.name, "http_post", url=action[len(self.base) - 1:][:120],
                         fields=[k for k, _ in data if k not in form.hidden], landed=result.url[len(self.base) - 1:][:80],
                         status=result.status, seconds=result.seconds)
        result.asked = result.url
        return self._keep(result)

    async def collect(self, target: str, base: str | None = None, limit: int = MAX_PAGES) -> list[Page]:
        """A list a model chose, and its further pages along the next-page links (or load-more targets)."""
        first = await self.get(target, base)
        pages, seen = [first], {first.url}
        while len(pages) < limit:
            nxt = next((h for t, h in pages[-1].targets() if NEXT.search(t) and not NOT_NEXT.search(t)
                        and self.url(h, pages[-1].url) not in seen and self.on_site(self.url(h, pages[-1].url))), None)
            if nxt is None:
                break
            page = await self.get(nxt, pages[-1].url)
            if page.url in seen or page.text == pages[-1].text:
                break  # past the end, a site repeats its last page
            seen.add(page.url)
            pages.append(page)
        self.trace.event(self.name, "http_collect", url=target[:120], pages=len(pages))
        return pages

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ signing in

    async def relogin(self, seen_logins: int) -> None:
        """Sign in again unless another request already did since `seen_logins` (parallel requests that all saw
        the sign-in page would otherwise sign in one after another, each ending the session of the one before)."""
        async with self.relogin_lock:
            if self.logins != seen_logins:
                return
            self.trace.event(self.name, "http_session_ended")
            await self.sign_in()

    async def sign_in(self, page: Page | None = None) -> Page:
        """Sign in with the run's credentials through the site's own form, then accept the minimal cookie choice."""
        async with self.login_lock:
            if page is None or self._signin(page) is None:
                response = await self._request("GET", self.base)
                page = await self._page(response, self.base)
            form = self._signin(page)
            if form is not None:
                creds = self.site.get("credentials") or {}
                values = {}
                user = next((f for f in form.fields if f.kind in ("text", "email", "") and f.kind != "password"), None)
                for f in form.fields:
                    if f.kind == "password":
                        values[f.name] = creds.get("password", "")
                if user is not None:
                    values[user.name] = creds.get("username", "")
                action = self.url(form.action or page.url, page.url)
                response = await self._request("POST", action, data=form.data(values))
                page = await self._page(response, action)
                self.logins += 1
            page = await self._consent(page)
            self.ok = self._signin(page) is None
            self.trace.event(self.name, "http_signed_in", ok=self.ok, landed=page.url[len(self.base) - 1:][:80],
                             logins=self.logins)
            page.asked = page.url
            self.home = self._keep(page)
            return page

    async def _consent(self, page: Page) -> Page:
        """A cookie notice whose form has nothing to fill: the minimal (necessary-only) choice, as in the browser."""
        for _ in range(2):
            if not COOKIE.search(page.text):
                return page
            choice = None
            for form in page.forms:
                visible = [f for f in form.fields if f.kind not in ("hidden",)]
                if visible or not form.buttons or LOGOUT.search(form.action):
                    continue
                minimal = [b for b in form.buttons if COOKIE_MINIMAL.search(b[2])]
                answers = [b for b in form.buttons if COOKIE_ANSWER.search(b[2]) and not LOGOUT.search(b[2])]
                if minimal or len(answers) == 1:
                    choice = (form, (minimal or answers)[0])
                    break
            if choice is None:
                return page
            form, button = choice
            action = self.url(form.action or page.url, page.url)
            response = await self._request("POST", action, data=form.data({}, button[2]))
            page = await self._page(response, action)
        return page

    async def start(self) -> Page:
        """Signed in, on the page the start address lands on."""
        page = await self.sign_in()
        return page

    async def close(self) -> None:
        try:
            await self.client.aclose()
        except Exception:
            pass

    def cookies(self) -> list[dict]:
        """The session cookies in Playwright's format, to hand the sign-in to a browser context."""
        out = []
        for c in self.client.cookies.jar:
            out.append({"name": c.name, "value": c.value, "domain": c.domain or self.host, "path": c.path or "/",
                        "secure": bool(c.secure), "httpOnly": True, "sameSite": "Lax"})
        return out

"""
A website of the run read over plain HTTP (AGENT_HTTP=1): sign-in, pages as text, forms, paging.

The websites render on the server, so a GET returns what a tab would show (http_read.html_view turns it into text)
in about 0.1 to 0.3 s. The sandbox reaches the websites only through HTTP(S)_PROXY; httpx honours it (trust_env).

Generic helpers only, as in the browser path: signing in with the run's credentials, accepting the minimal cookie
choice, retrying a flaky error page, signing in again when the session ends, putting same-site frames in place and
following a list's next-page links when a model asked for that list. Which pages are read, which searches are made
and which forms are sent (e.g. an entry check that asks for a number shown on the page) is the model's choice
(http_nav.py).
"""
import asyncio
import os
import re
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from urllib.parse import urlencode, urljoin, urlparse, urlunparse, parse_qsl

import httpx2

from http_read import Form, html_view

USER_AGENT = "error404ai-rfq-agent/2 (+http)"
FETCH_SECONDS = float(os.environ.get("HTTP_FETCH_SECONDS", "12"))  # one request; a stalled one is tried again
TRIES = 3  # an error page or a stalled request is tried this often
FRAME_DEPTH = 2
MAX_PAGES = 25  # list pages followed per collect()
PARALLEL = int(os.environ.get("HTTP_PARALLEL", "8"))  # requests at once per website

ERROR_PAGE = re.compile(r"vorübergehend nicht verfügbar|temporarily unavailable|service unavailable|bad gateway|"
                        r"gateway time-?out|internal server error|bitte versuchen sie es (später )?erneut",
                        re.IGNORECASE)
COOKIE = re.compile(r"cookie", re.IGNORECASE)
COOKIE_MINIMAL = re.compile(r"notwendig|erforderlich|necessary|essential|nur technisch|ablehnen|reject|decline",
                            re.IGNORECASE)
COOKIE_ANSWER = re.compile(r"akzeptier|accept|zustimm|agree|erlaub|allow|bestätig|confirm|ok\b", re.IGNORECASE)
LOGOUT = re.compile(r"log-?out|sign-?out|log off|abmeld", re.IGNORECASE)
NEXT = re.compile(r"^\s*(weiter|mehr|nächste|naechste|next|more|load more|show more|weitere|folgende|vorwärts|"
                  r"vorwaerts|›|»|>|→)", re.IGNORECASE)
NOT_NEXT = re.compile(r"zurück|zurueck|vorherige|previous|prev|back|erste|first|letzte|last", re.IGNORECASE)
LINK = re.compile(r'\[link "([^"]*)" -> (\S+?)\]')
TARGET_BUTTON = re.compile(r'\[button "([^"]*)"[^\]]*? -> (\S+?)\]')
FRAME = re.compile(r"\[frame (\S+?)\]")


@dataclass
class Page:
    url: str  # where the request ended
    title: str
    text: str  # the view, frames in place
    forms: list[Form] = field(default_factory=list)
    status: int = 200
    seconds: float = 0.0
    asked: str = ""  # the address requested

    def targets(self) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
        """(text, target) of every link, target-carrying button and frame on the page."""
        out = [(t, h) for t, h in LINK.findall(self.text)] + [(t, h) for t, h in TARGET_BUTTON.findall(self.text)]
        out += [("frame", h) for h in FRAME.findall(self.text)]
        return out

    def view(self) -> str:
        return f"URL: {self.url}\nTitle: {self.title}\n\n{self.text}"


def _same(a: str, b: str) -> bool:
    pa, pb = urlparse(a), urlparse(b)
    return pa.path.rstrip("/") == pb.path.rstrip("/") and sorted(parse_qsl(pa.query)) == sorted(parse_qsl(pb.query))


class HttpSite:
    """One website: a cookie session of its own, the pages read so far, and what the readers may quote (seen)."""

    def __init__(self, site: dict, trace, tag: str = ""):
        self.site, self.trace = site, trace
        self.name = site["siteId"] + (f":{tag}" if tag else "")
        self.base = site["url"].rstrip("/") + "/"
        self.host = urlparse(self.base).netloc
        self.client = httpx2.AsyncClient(follow_redirects=True, timeout=FETCH_SECONDS, trust_env=True,
                                         headers={"User-Agent": USER_AGENT, "Accept": "text/html,*/*"})
        self.limit = asyncio.Semaphore(PARALLEL)
        self.pages: dict[str, Page] = {}  # by requested and by final address
        self.seen = ""  # every page text read, for grounding checks
        self.view = ""  # the latest page's text (what helpers written for tabs look at)
        self.logins = 0
        self.login_lock = asyncio.Lock()
        self.relogin_lock = asyncio.Lock()
        self.ok = False
        self.home: Page | None = None
        self.requests = 0
        self.request_seconds = 0.0

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ requests

    def url(self, target: str, base: str | None = None) -> str:
        return urljoin(base or self.base, target.strip())

    def on_site(self, url: str) -> bool:
        return urlparse(url).netloc == self.host

    async def _request(self, method: str, url: str, data=None):
        last = None
        for attempt in range(TRIES):
            began = time.monotonic()
            try:
                async with self.limit:
                    if method == "GET":
                        response = await self.client.get(url)
                    else:
                        response = await self.client.post(  # a list keeps repeated names (checkbox groups)
                            url, content=urlencode(data or []).encode(),
                            headers={"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"})
            except Exception as error:  # a stalled or refused request: once more
                last = error
                self.trace.event(self.name, "http_retry", url=url[:120], error=f"{type(error).__name__}")
                await asyncio.sleep(0.3 * (attempt + 1))
                continue
            finally:
                self.requests += 1
                self.request_seconds += time.monotonic() - began
            flaky = response.status_code >= 500 or (len(response.text) < 30000 and ERROR_PAGE.search(response.text))
            if flaky and attempt + 1 < TRIES:
                await asyncio.sleep(0.4 * (attempt + 1))
                if method != "GET":  # a post that landed on an error page: read where it went instead
                    method, url, data = "GET", str(response.url), None
                continue
            return response
        raise ConnectionError(f"{method} {url} failed: {type(last).__name__ if last else 'error page'}")

    def _signin(self, page: Page) -> Form | None:
        for form in page.forms:
            if any(f.kind == "password" for f in form.fields):
                return form
        return None

    async def _page(self, response, asked: str, depth: int = 0) -> Page:
        final = str(response.url)
        if "html" not in response.headers.get("content-type", "html"):
            text = response.text[:60000]
            return Page(final, "", text, [], response.status_code, asked=asked)
        view = html_view(response.text)
        text = view.text
        if depth < FRAME_DEPTH and view.frames:
            subs = await asyncio.gather(*(self._frame(self.url(src, final), depth) for src in view.frames))
            for i, sub in enumerate(subs):
                text = text.replace(f"\x00FRAME{i}\x00", sub)
        text = re.sub(r"\x00FRAME\d+\x00", "", text)
        return Page(final, view.title, re.sub(r"\n{2,}", "\n", text), view.forms, response.status_code, asked=asked)

    async def _frame(self, url: str, depth: int) -> str:
        if not url.startswith("http") or not self.on_site(url):
            return "(separate)"
        cached = self.pages.get(url)
        if cached is not None:
            return cached.text
        try:
            response = await self._request("GET", url)
            page = await self._page(response, url, depth + 1)
        except Exception as error:
            return f"(not read: {type(error).__name__})"
        return page.text

    def _keep(self, page: Page) -> Page:
        self.pages[page.asked or page.url] = page
        self.pages.setdefault(page.url, page)
        self.seen += "\n" + page.text
        self.view = page.text
        self.trace.event(self.name, "view", quiet=True, url=page.url, text=page.text, http=True)
        return page

    async def get(self, target: str, base: str | None = None, fresh: bool = False) -> Page:
        """The page at a target (relative to `base` or the site), signed in again if the session ended."""
        url = self.url(target, base)
        if not fresh and url in self.pages:
            return self.pages[url]
        began = time.monotonic()
        logins = self.logins
        response = await self._request("GET", url)
        page = await self._page(response, url)
        if self.ok and self._signin(page) is not None:
            # the session ended: sign in again (once, however many requests noticed it) and ask again
            await self.relogin(logins)
            response = await self._request("GET", url)
            page = await self._page(response, url)
        page.seconds = round(time.monotonic() - began, 2)
        self.trace.event(self.name, "http_get", url=url[len(self.base) - 1:][:140] if url.startswith(self.base) else url[:140],
                         landed=page.url[len(self.base) - 1:][:80] if not _same(url, page.url) else "",
                         status=page.status, seconds=page.seconds, chars=len(page.text))
        return self._keep(page)

    async def submit(self, page: Page, number: int, values: dict[str, str], button: str = "") -> Page:
        """Send form `number` (1-based, as the page text numbers it) of `page` with the given field values."""
        form = page.forms[number - 1]
        data = form.data(values, button)
        action = self.url(form.action or page.url, page.url)
        began = time.monotonic()
        if form.method == "get":
            parsed = urlparse(action)
            url = urlunparse(parsed._replace(query=urlencode(data)))
            return await self.get(url, fresh=True)
        logins = self.logins
        response = await self._request("POST", action, data=data)
        result = await self._page(response, action)
        if self.ok and self._signin(result) is not None:
            # the session had ended: signed in again, the model gets the page the site now shows (it may have to
            # send the form again from that page)
            await self.relogin(logins)
            response = await self._request("GET", page.url)
            result = await self._page(response, page.url)
        result.seconds = round(time.monotonic() - began, 2)
        self.trace.event(self.name, "http_post", url=action[len(self.base) - 1:][:120],
                         fields=[k for k, _ in data if k not in form.hidden], landed=result.url[len(self.base) - 1:][:80],
                         status=result.status, seconds=result.seconds)
        result.asked = result.url
        return self._keep(result)

    async def collect(self, target: str, base: str | None = None, limit: int = MAX_PAGES) -> list[Page]:
        """A list a model chose, and its further pages along the next-page links (or load-more targets)."""
        first = await self.get(target, base)
        pages, seen = [first], {first.url}
        while len(pages) < limit:
            nxt = next((h for t, h in pages[-1].targets() if NEXT.search(t) and not NOT_NEXT.search(t)
                        and self.url(h, pages[-1].url) not in seen and self.on_site(self.url(h, pages[-1].url))), None)
            if nxt is None:
                break
            page = await self.get(nxt, pages[-1].url)
            if page.url in seen or page.text == pages[-1].text:
                break  # past the end, a site repeats its last page
            seen.add(page.url)
            pages.append(page)
        self.trace.event(self.name, "http_collect", url=target[:120], pages=len(pages))
        return pages

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ signing in

    async def relogin(self, seen_logins: int) -> None:
        """Sign in again unless another request already did since `seen_logins` (parallel requests that all saw
        the sign-in page would otherwise sign in one after another, each ending the session of the one before)."""
        async with self.relogin_lock:
            if self.logins != seen_logins:
                return
            self.trace.event(self.name, "http_session_ended")
            await self.sign_in()

    async def sign_in(self, page: Page | None = None) -> Page:
        """Sign in with the run's credentials through the site's own form, then accept the minimal cookie choice."""
        async with self.login_lock:
            if page is None or self._signin(page) is None:
                response = await self._request("GET", self.base)
                page = await self._page(response, self.base)
            form = self._signin(page)
            if form is not None:
                creds = self.site.get("credentials") or {}
                values = {}
                user = next((f for f in form.fields if f.kind in ("text", "email", "") and f.kind != "password"), None)
                for f in form.fields:
                    if f.kind == "password":
                        values[f.name] = creds.get("password", "")
                if user is not None:
                    values[user.name] = creds.get("username", "")
                action = self.url(form.action or page.url, page.url)
                response = await self._request("POST", action, data=form.data(values))
                page = await self._page(response, action)
                self.logins += 1
            page = await self._consent(page)
            self.ok = self._signin(page) is None
            self.trace.event(self.name, "http_signed_in", ok=self.ok, landed=page.url[len(self.base) - 1:][:80],
                             logins=self.logins)
            page.asked = page.url
            self.home = self._keep(page)
            return page

    async def _consent(self, page: Page) -> Page:
        """A cookie notice whose form has nothing to fill: the minimal (necessary-only) choice, as in the browser."""
        for _ in range(2):
            if not COOKIE.search(page.text):
                return page
            choice = None
            for form in page.forms:
                visible = [f for f in form.fields if f.kind not in ("hidden",)]
                if visible or not form.buttons or LOGOUT.search(form.action):
                    continue
                minimal = [b for b in form.buttons if COOKIE_MINIMAL.search(b[2])]
                answers = [b for b in form.buttons if COOKIE_ANSWER.search(b[2]) and not LOGOUT.search(b[2])]
                if minimal or len(answers) == 1:
                    choice = (form, (minimal or answers)[0])
                    break
            if choice is None:
                return page
            form, button = choice
            action = self.url(form.action or page.url, page.url)
            response = await self._request("POST", action, data=form.data({}, button[2]))
            page = await self._page(response, action)
        return page

    async def start(self) -> Page:
        """Signed in, on the page the start address lands on."""
        page = await self.sign_in()
        return page

    async def close(self) -> None:
        try:
            await self.client.aclose()
        except Exception:
            pass

    def cookies(self) -> list[dict]:
        """The session cookies in Playwright's format, to hand the sign-in to a browser context."""
        out = []
        for c in self.client.cookies.jar:
            out.append({"name": c.name, "value": c.value, "domain": c.domain or self.host, "path": c.path or "/",
                        "secure": bool(c.secure), "httpOnly": True, "sameSite": "Lax"})
        return out

"""
A model browses a website over HTTP in a few large steps (AGENT_HTTP=1).

Each step the model sees the goal and the pages read so far as text (links as `[link "text" -> target]`, frames in
place, forms numbered `[form N METHOD -> action]` with their fields) and answers with everything it wants next, all
at once: link targets to open, search addresses with its query filled in, forms to send with its field values, and
lists to follow through their next pages. It names the pages that hold the facts for each category of the goal
("keep") and says when it is done. The helpers only fetch what it named, in parallel, and page the lists it chose.

Fair play: every address comes from the model, and must be one a page showed (a link, button or frame target, or a
search form's own address with a query) or a form a page showed; anything else is sent back to it. Nothing is
crawled: a page is read only when the model asked for it.
"""
import asyncio
import re
import time
from urllib.parse import urlparse

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from pydantic_ai import Agent, ModelRetry

import llm
from http_site import LOGOUT, HttpSite, Page, _same

PAGE_CHARS = 9000  # one page shown to the navigator at most (the readers get it whole)
NAV_TIMEOUT = 45.0

INSTRUCTIONS = """\
You research one website for a bid by reading its pages as text. You cannot click; you request pages:
- `target`: a link, button or frame target exactly as a page shows it after "->" (or a frame's address). A search
  form can also be used as an address: the form's action with the query string filled in (as shown after
  "search address:"), e.g. /search?q=your+words.
- `page` + `form` + `fields`: send form number N of that page with field values by field name (for a radio or
  checkbox give the value to choose; a confirmation that asks you to copy a number shown on the page needs that
  number exactly). Hidden fields are added for you. Name the `button` if the form has several submit buttons.
- `all_pages`: also follow that list's next-page links, so every page of a long list or paged document is read
  in one request. Use it on the first page you request of anything paged; never guess the addresses of later
  pages.
- `keep_as`: the category the requested page(s) answer, when you already know (saves a step).
Request everything you need next in one step; independent pages go side by side. In `keep`, list per category the
addresses of pages already read that show its facts themselves (all of them, e.g. every page of a list), not
the lists or menus that only lead there. A page shown again after a form or a new sign-in replaces its earlier
version; a sign-in can also undo an earlier confirmation, so check the newest version. Set done once the
kept pages cover every category (or the site does not have it). Never invent addresses. Ignore decoys: pop-ups and
offers ("accept and continue"), surveys, fake browser bars and download bars, and pages of other records than the
ones the goal names."""


class Request(BaseModel):
    target: str = Field("", description="A link/button/frame target as shown, or a search address with your query")
    page: str = Field("", description="To send a form instead: the address of the page that shows it")
    form: int = Field(0, description="The form's number on that page ([form N ...])")
    fields: dict[str, str] = Field(default_factory=dict, description="Form field values by field name")
    button: str = Field("", description="The submit button's label, if the form has several")
    all_pages: bool = Field(False, description="Also follow the list's next-page links")
    keep_as: str = Field("", description="The goal category the resulting page(s) answer, if known")


class Keep(BaseModel):
    category: str
    pages: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Addresses of pages read so far that hold this category's facts")


class Step(BaseModel):
    requests: list[Request] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Everything to read next, at once")
    keep: list[Keep] = Field(default_factory=list)
    done: bool = Field(False, description="True once the kept pages cover every category")
    note: str = Field("", description="A few words on what you do or found")


def _host_path(url: str) -> str:
    p = urlparse(url)
    return p.path + (f"?{p.query}" if p.query else "")


class Navigator:
    def __init__(self, site: HttpSite, goal: str, categories: dict[str, str], *, thinking: bool = False,
                 rounds: int = 8, deadline: float | None = None, name: str = ""):
        self.site, self.goal, self.categories = site, goal, categories
        self.thinking, self.rounds, self.deadline = thinking, rounds, deadline
        self.name = name or site.name
        self.shown: list[Page] = []  # pages in the order the model got them
        self.kept: dict[str, list[str]] = {c: [] for c in categories}
        self.notes: list[str] = []
        self.calls = 0
        self.shown_lines: set[str] = set()
        self.rendered: list[str] = []  # each shown page as the model saw it (stable, so the prompt prefix caches)
        self.round_of: list[int] = []  # the round each page arrived in
        self.round = 0

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ what the model sees

    def _render(self, page: Page) -> str:
        lines, out = page.text.splitlines(), []
        for line in lines:
            chrome = "[link" in line or "[button" in line or "[form" in line or "[/form" in line or len(line) < 60
            if chrome and line in self.shown_lines and not re.search(r"\d{2,}", line):
                continue
            out.append(line)
            self.shown_lines.add(line)
        text = "\n".join(out)
        if len(text) > PAGE_CHARS:
            text = text[:PAGE_CHARS] + f"\n[... {len(text) - PAGE_CHARS} more characters not shown]"
        older = sum(1 for p in self.shown[:-1] if _same(p.url, page.url))
        again = f" (shown again, newer version {older + 1}: only this version counts)" if older else ""
        return f"=== PAGE {_host_path(page.url)}{again}\nTitle: {page.title}\n{text}"

    def show(self, page: Page) -> None:
        if any(p is page for p in self.shown):
            return
        self.shown.append(page)
        self.rendered.append(self._render(page))
        self.round_of.append(self.round)

    @staticmethod
    def _condense(rendered: str) -> str:
        """An older page in short: its header, headings, links, controls and short lines (its text was shown in
        full when it arrived)."""
        lines = rendered.splitlines()
        keep = lines[:2] + [ln for ln in lines[2:] if ln.startswith("#") or "[" in ln or len(ln) < 50]
        text = "\n".join(keep)
        if len(text) > 2500:
            text = text[:2500] + "\n[...]"
        return text + "\n(older page, shown in short)"

    def prompt(self) -> str:
        cats = "\n".join(f"- {c}: {d}" for c, d in self.categories.items())
        kept = "\n".join(f"- {c}: {', '.join(_host_path(u) for u in us) or '(none yet)'}" for c, us in self.kept.items())
        notes = ("\nResults of your last requests:\n" + "\n".join(self.notes[-12:])) if self.notes else ""
        shown = [r if self.round - n <= 1 else self._condense(r) for r, n in zip(self.rendered, self.round_of)]
        return (f"Goal: {self.goal}\nCategories to keep:\n{cats}\n\nPages read so far (oldest first):\n\n"
                + "\n\n".join(shown) + f"\n\nKept so far:\n{kept}{notes}\n\nYour next step:")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ checks

    def _known_targets(self) -> set[str]:
        out = set()
        for page in self.shown:
            for _, href in page.targets():
                out.add(_host_path(self.site.url(href, page.url)))
        return out

    def _form_paths(self) -> set[str]:
        out = set()
        for page in self.shown:
            for form in page.forms:
                if form.method == "get":
                    out.add(urlparse(self.site.url(form.action or page.url, page.url)).path.rstrip("/"))
        return out

    def _page(self, address: str) -> Page | None:
        url = self.site.url(address)
        for page in reversed(self.shown):
            if _same(page.url, url) or (page.asked and _same(page.asked, url)):
                return page
        return None

    def check(self, step: Step) -> list[str]:
        problems = []
        known, forms = self._known_targets(), self._form_paths()
        for r in step.requests:  # a page named without a form number means: open that page
            if not r.target and not r.form and r.page:
                r.target, r.page = r.page, ""
        for r in step.requests:
            if r.form:
                page = self._page(r.page) if r.page else None
                if page is None:
                    problems.append(f"form request: page {r.page!r} is not one you have read")
                elif not 1 <= r.form <= len(page.forms):
                    problems.append(f"page {r.page} has forms 1 to {len(page.forms)}, not {r.form}")
                elif LOGOUT.search(page.forms[r.form - 1].action) or any(
                        LOGOUT.search(b[2]) for b in page.forms[r.form - 1].buttons):
                    problems.append(f"form {r.form} of {r.page} signs out; pick the form you mean by its number")
                elif any(f.kind == "password" for f in page.forms[r.form - 1].fields):
                    problems.append(f"form {r.form} of {r.page} is a sign-in: signing in is done for you with the "
                                    f"run's own login (never enter credentials); request the page you want again")
                continue
            if not r.target:
                continue  # an empty request: nothing to do
            url = self.site.url(r.target, self.shown[-1].url if self.shown else None)
            if not self.site.on_site(url):
                problems.append(f"{r.target} is not on this website")
            elif _host_path(url) not in known and urlparse(url).path.rstrip("/") not in forms:
                problems.append(f"{r.target} appears on no page you have read (use targets exactly as shown, or a "
                                f"search form's own address with a query)")
        for k in step.keep:
            if k.category not in self.categories:
                problems.append(f"category {k.category!r} is not one of {sorted(self.categories)}")
            for address in k.pages:
                if self._page(address) is None:
                    problems.append(f"kept page {address!r} has not been read (keep only pages read so far)")
        for r in step.requests:
            if r.keep_as and r.keep_as not in self.categories:
                problems.append(f"keep_as {r.keep_as!r} is not one of {sorted(self.categories)}")
        return problems

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ the loop

    async def _ask(self) -> Step:
        agent = Agent(llm.model(), output_type=Step, instructions=INSTRUCTIONS,
                      model_settings=llm.settings(self.thinking, timeout=NAV_TIMEOUT if not self.thinking else 90.0),
                      retries=3)

        @agent.output_validator
        def _valid(step: Step) -> Step:
            problems = self.check(step)
            if problems:
                self.site.trace.event(self.name, "nav_refused", problems=problems[:6])
                raise ModelRetry("; ".join(problems[:8]))
            return step

        self.calls += 1
        return (await agent.run(self.prompt())).output

    async def _run(self, r: Request) -> list[Page]:
        if r.form:
            page = self._page(r.page)
            assert page is not None
            return [await self.site.submit(page, r.form, r.fields, r.button)]
        base = self.shown[-1].url if self.shown else None
        if r.all_pages:
            return await self.site.collect(r.target, base)
        return [await self.site.get(r.target, base)]

    async def run(self, start: list[Page]) -> dict[str, list[Page]]:
        for page in start:
            self.show(page)
        began = time.monotonic()
        for i in range(self.rounds):
            self.round = i + 1
            if self.deadline is not None and time.monotonic() > self.deadline:
                self.site.trace.event(self.name, "nav_deadline", round=i)
                break
            t = time.monotonic()
            try:
                step = await self._ask()
            except Exception as error:
                self.site.trace.event(self.name, "nav_failed", error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}")
                break
            for k in step.keep:
                for address in k.pages:
                    page = self._page(address)
                    if page is not None and page.url not in self.kept[k.category]:
                        self.kept[k.category].append(page.url)
            self.site.trace.event(self.name, "nav_step", round=i + 1, seconds=round(time.monotonic() - t, 1),
                                  requests=[r.target or f"form {r.form}@{r.page} {r.fields}" for r in step.requests][:20],
                                  done=step.done, note=step.note[:160],
                                  kept={c: len(u) for c, u in self.kept.items()})
            requests = [r for r in step.requests if r.target or r.form]
            if requests:
                results = await asyncio.gather(*(self._run(r) for r in requests), return_exceptions=True)
                self.notes = []
                for r, res in zip(requests, results):
                    label = r.target or f"form {r.form} of {r.page}"
                    if isinstance(res, BaseException):
                        self.notes.append(f"- {label}: failed ({type(res).__name__}: {str(res)[:100]})")
                        continue
                    for page in res:
                        self.show(page)
                        if r.keep_as and page.url not in self.kept[r.keep_as]:
                            self.kept[r.keep_as].append(page.url)
                    landed = res[-1].url if res else ""
                    if r.form:
                        self.notes.append(f"- {label}: sent; the site now shows {_host_path(landed)} "
                                          f"({res[-1].title if res else ''}), shown above as its newest version")
                        continue
                    moved = landed and not _same(landed, self.site.url(r.target, None))
                    self.notes.append(f"- {label}: {len(res)} page(s)" + (f", landed on {_host_path(landed)}"
                                                                            if moved else ""))
            if step.done:
                break
        self.site.trace.event(self.name, "nav_done", seconds=round(time.monotonic() - began, 1), calls=self.calls,
                              pages=len(self.shown), kept={c: [_host_path(u) for u in us] for c, us in self.kept.items()})
        return {c: [p for u in us if (p := self._page(u)) is not None] for c, us in self.kept.items()}

        notes = ("\nResults of your last requests:\n" + "\n".join(self.notes[-12:])) if self.notes else ""
        shown = [r if self.round - n <= 1 else self._condense(r) for r, n in zip(self.rendered, self.round_of)]
        return (f"Goal: {self.goal}\nCategories to keep:\n{cats}\n\nPages read so far (oldest first):\n\n"
                + "\n\n".join(shown) + f"\n\nKept so far:\n{kept}{notes}\n\nYour next step:")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ checks

    def _known_targets(self) -> set[str]:
        out = set()
        for page in self.shown:
            for _, href in page.targets():
                out.add(_host_path(self.site.url(href, page.url)))
        return out

    def _form_paths(self) -> set[str]:
        out = set()
        for page in self.shown:
            for form in page.forms:
                if form.method == "get":
                    out.add(urlparse(self.site.url(form.action or page.url, page.url)).path.rstrip("/"))
        return out

    def _page(self, address: str) -> Page | None:
        url = self.site.url(address)
        for page in reversed(self.shown):
            if _same(page.url, url) or (page.asked and _same(page.asked, url)):
                return page
        return None

    def check(self, step: Step) -> list[str]:
        problems = []
        known, forms = self._known_targets(), self._form_paths()
        for r in step.requests:  # a page named without a form number means: open that page
            if not r.target and not r.form and r.page:
                r.target, r.page = r.page, ""
        for r in step.requests:
            if r.form:
                page = self._page(r.page) if r.page else None
                if page is None:
                    problems.append(f"form request: page {r.page!r} is not one you have read")
                elif not 1 <= r.form <= len(page.forms):
                    problems.append(f"page {r.page} has forms 1 to {len(page.forms)}, not {r.form}")
                elif LOGOUT.search(page.forms[r.form - 1].action) or any(
                        LOGOUT.search(b[2]) for b in page.forms[r.form - 1].buttons):
                    problems.append(f"form {r.form} of {r.page} signs out; pick the form you mean by its number")
                elif any(f.kind == "password" for f in page.forms[r.form - 1].fields):
                    problems.append(f"form {r.form} of {r.page} is a sign-in: signing in is done for you with the "
                                    f"run's own login (never enter credentials); request the page you want again")
                continue
            if not r.target:
                continue  # an empty request: nothing to do
            url = self.site.url(r.target, self.shown[-1].url if self.shown else None)
            if not self.site.on_site(url):
                problems.append(f"{r.target} is not on this website")
            elif _host_path(url) not in known and urlparse(url).path.rstrip("/") not in forms:
                problems.append(f"{r.target} appears on no page you have read (use targets exactly as shown, or a "
                                f"search form's own address with a query)")
        for k in step.keep:
            if k.category not in self.categories:
                problems.append(f"category {k.category!r} is not one of {sorted(self.categories)}")
            for address in k.pages:
                if self._page(address) is None:
                    problems.append(f"kept page {address!r} has not been read (keep only pages read so far)")
        for r in step.requests:
            if r.keep_as and r.keep_as not in self.categories:
                problems.append(f"keep_as {r.keep_as!r} is not one of {sorted(self.categories)}")
        return problems

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ the loop

    async def _ask(self) -> Step:
        agent = Agent(llm.model(), output_type=Step, instructions=INSTRUCTIONS,
                      model_settings=llm.settings(self.thinking, timeout=NAV_TIMEOUT if not self.thinking else 90.0),
                      retries=3)

        @agent.output_validator
        def _valid(step: Step) -> Step:
            problems = self.check(step)
            if problems:
                self.site.trace.event(self.name, "nav_refused", problems=problems[:6])
                raise ModelRetry("; ".join(problems[:8]))
            return step

        self.calls += 1
        return (await agent.run(self.prompt())).output

    async def _run(self, r: Request) -> list[Page]:
        if r.form:
            page = self._page(r.page)
            assert page is not None
            return [await self.site.submit(page, r.form, r.fields, r.button)]
        base = self.shown[-1].url if self.shown else None
        if r.all_pages:
            return await self.site.collect(r.target, base)
        return [await self.site.get(r.target, base)]

    async def run(self, start: list[Page]) -> dict[str, list[Page]]:
        for page in start:
            self.show(page)
        began = time.monotonic()
        for i in range(self.rounds):
            self.round = i + 1
            if self.deadline is not None and time.monotonic() > self.deadline:
                self.site.trace.event(self.name, "nav_deadline", round=i)
                break
            t = time.monotonic()
            try:
                step = await self._ask()
            except Exception as error:
                self.site.trace.event(self.name, "nav_failed", error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}")
                break
            for k in step.keep:
                for address in k.pages:
                    page = self._page(address)
                    if page is not None and page.url not in self.kept[k.category]:
                        self.kept[k.category].append(page.url)
            self.site.trace.event(self.name, "nav_step", round=i + 1, seconds=round(time.monotonic() - t, 1),
                                  requests=[r.target or f"form {r.form}@{r.page} {r.fields}" for r in step.requests][:20],
                                  done=step.done, note=step.note[:160],
                                  kept={c: len(u) for c, u in self.kept.items()})
            requests = [r for r in step.requests if r.target or r.form]
            if requests:
                results = await asyncio.gather(*(self._run(r) for r in requests), return_exceptions=True)
                self.notes = []
                for r, res in zip(requests, results):
                    label = r.target or f"form {r.form} of {r.page}"
                    if isinstance(res, BaseException):
                        self.notes.append(f"- {label}: failed ({type(res).__name__}: {str(res)[:100]})")
                        continue
                    for page in res:
                        self.show(page)
                        if r.keep_as and page.url not in self.kept[r.keep_as]:
                            self.kept[r.keep_as].append(page.url)
                    landed = res[-1].url if res else ""
                    if r.form:
                        self.notes.append(f"- {label}: sent; the site now shows {_host_path(landed)} "
                                          f"({res[-1].title if res else ''}), shown above as its newest version")
                        continue
                    moved = landed and not _same(landed, self.site.url(r.target, None))
                    self.notes.append(f"- {label}: {len(res)} page(s)" + (f", landed on {_host_path(landed)}"
                                                                            if moved else ""))
            if step.done:
                break
        self.site.trace.event(self.name, "nav_done", seconds=round(time.monotonic() - began, 1), calls=self.calls,
                              pages=len(self.shown), kept={c: [_host_path(u) for u in us] for c, us in self.kept.items()})
        return {c: [p for u in us if (p := self._page(u)) is not None] for c, us in self.kept.items()}

class CurrentRevision(BaseModel):

    document: str = Field(description="The specification document's number or title as shown")
    why: str = Field(description="What marks it as current, in a few words")


def _views(pages: list[Page]) -> str:
    return "\n\n".join(p.view() for p in pages)


def _dedupe(pages: list[Page]) -> list[Page]:
    out, seen = [], set()
    for p in pages:
        if p.text not in seen:
            seen.add(p.text)
            out.append(p)
    return out


class _Here:
    """What _post_tender and similar helpers read from a session: the page it is on."""
    def __init__(self, url: str):
        self.url = url


class HttpOrchestrator(Orchestrator):
    """The orchestrator with HTTP research; verify, material choice, calc and the answer are the base class's."""

    def __init__(self, task: dict, briefing: Briefing, trace: Trace, deadline: float,
                 sites: dict[str, HttpSite], starts: dict[str, asyncio.Task]):
        super().__init__(task, briefing, {}, trace, deadline)
        self.sites, self.starts = sites, starts
        self.http_plan: Plan | None = None  # self.plan stays None: the browser gap retries do not apply here
        self.http_seconds: dict[str, float] = {}

    async def home(self, site: str) -> Page:
        page = await self.starts[site]
        return page

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ the pipeline

    async def research(self) -> None:
        started = time.monotonic()
        sites = {s["siteId"]: s["url"] for s in self.task["access"]}
        mail_plan = asyncio.create_task(research_mail.plan_searches(self.task["brief"], sites))
        self.http_plan = await plan_research(self.task, self.briefing)
        self.trace.event("plan", "done", needs=[f"{n.kind}@{n.site}" for n in self.http_plan.needs])
        where: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
        for n in self.http_plan.needs:
            if n.site in self.sites and n.site not in where.setdefault(n.kind, []):
                where[n.kind].append(n.site)
        jobs = [asyncio.create_task(self._timed(self.tender(s), f"tender@{s}")) for s in where.get("tender", [])[:1]]
        spec_sites, erp_sites = where.get("specification", []), where.get("materials", [])
        if spec_sites:
            jobs.append(asyncio.create_task(self._timed(
                self.specification_and_erp(spec_sites[0], erp_sites[0] if erp_sites else None), "spec+erp")))
        jobs += [asyncio.create_task(self._timed(self.mails_http(s, mail_plan), f"mails@{s}"))
                 for s in where.get("mails", [])[:1]]
        done, pending = await asyncio.wait(jobs, timeout=max(1.0, self.left()))
        for job in pending:
            job.cancel()
            self.board.problem("deadline", f"{job.get_name()} stopped at the research deadline")
        if pending:
            await asyncio.gather(*pending, return_exceptions=True)
        if not mail_plan.done():
            mail_plan.cancel()
        self.trace.event("http", "research_done", seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 1),
                         parts=self.http_seconds,
                         requests={n: s.requests for n, s in self.sites.items()})

    async def _timed(self, coro, name: str) -> None:
        began = time.monotonic()
        try:
            await coro
        except Exception as error:
            self.board.problem(name, f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}")
            self.trace.event("http", "part_failed", part=name, error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}")
        finally:
            self.http_seconds[name] = round(time.monotonic() - began, 1)

    def _deadline(self) -> float:
        return self.research_deadline - 30

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ tender

    async def tender(self, site_id: str) -> None:
        site = self.sites[site_id]
        started = time.monotonic()
        home = await self.home(site_id)
        nav = Navigator(site, TENDER_GOAL.format(reference=self.reference),
                        {"positions": "the document(s) listing the positions with original quantities and units",
                         "qa": "every page of the bidder questions and answers"},
                        deadline=self._deadline(), name=f"{site_id}:tender")
        kept = await nav.run([home])
        docs = _dedupe(kept["positions"])
        qa = _dedupe(kept["qa"])
        positions_text = _views(docs) or site.seen
        positions, records = await asyncio.gather(
            research_tender.read_positions(positions_text, self.reference),
            research_tender.read_qa([p.view() for p in qa], self.reference) if qa else _no_qa())
        site_view = _SiteView(site)
        facts = research_tender._finish(site_view, positions, records, bool(qa), self.scenario, started, None)
        if facts is None:
            self.board.problem("tender", "no positions and no Q&A read")
            return
        self.tender_facts = facts
        self.tender_reads[site_id] = facts
        self._post_tender(facts, site_id, site_view)
        self.board.finish("position")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ specification, then ERP

    async def specification_and_erp(self, spec_site: str, erp_site: str | None) -> None:
        erp_ready = asyncio.create_task(self.home(erp_site)) if erp_site else None
        try:
            await self.specification_http(spec_site)
        finally:
            self.board.finish("requirement")
        if erp_site is None or not self.requirements:
            self.board.finish("material")
            return
        if erp_ready is not None:
            await erp_ready
        try:
            self.erp = await self.erp_http(erp_site)
            await self._post_materials(erp_site)
        finally:
            self.board.finish("material")

    async def specification_http(self, site_id: str) -> None:
        site = self.sites[site_id]
        started = time.monotonic()
        home = await self.home(site_id)
        title = self.task["brief"].split("\n\n")[1][:300] if "\n\n" in self.task["brief"] else ""
        nav = Navigator(site, SPEC_GOAL.format(reference=self.reference, title=title),
                        {"history": "the page listing the specification's revisions with their status",
                         "requirements": "requirement pages of the currently valid revision (all pages)"},
                        deadline=self._deadline(), name=f"{site_id}:spec")
        kept = await nav.run([home])
        # the newest version of each kept history page (a confirmation or a new sign-in changes what a page shows),
        # else the newest page read that lists revisions
        newest = {p.url: p for p in nav.shown}
        history = [newest.get(p.url, p) for p in kept["history"]]
        history = [p for p in history if len(re.findall(r"revision", p.text, re.I)) >= 2] or [
            p for p in reversed(nav.shown) if len(re.findall(r"revision", p.text, re.I)) >= 3][:1]
        if not history:
            self.board.problem("specification", "no revision history found")
            return
        choice = await self._choose_revision(history[-1])
        if choice is None:
            self.board.problem("specification", "no current revision chosen")
            return
        revision = choice.revision.strip()
        self.trace.event(site_id, "spec_revision", revision=revision, why=choice.why)
        # every requirement page of that revision: a short navigation from what was read (it may be done at once)
        seen = [p for p in kept["requirements"] if revision in p.text]
        nav2 = Navigator(site, SPEC_PAGES_GOAL.format(revision=revision),
                         {"requirements": f"every requirement page of revision {revision}"},
                         deadline=self._deadline(), name=f"{site_id}:spec-pages", rounds=4)
        more = await nav2.run(_dedupe(history[-1:] + seen))
        pages = _dedupe([p for p in more["requirements"] + seen if revision in p.text])
        context = f"Tender reference: {self.reference}"
        extracted = await asyncio.gather(*(_extract_page(p.text, choice.document, revision, context, self.trace,
                                                         site_id) for p in pages))
        result = SpecResult(document=choice.document, current_revision=revision)
        by_id = {}
        for page in extracted:
            if page is None:
                result.problems.append("a document page could not be extracted")
                continue
            if page.revision_shown and not same_revision(page.revision_shown, revision):
                continue
            for seen in page.requirements:
                try:
                    req = _parse_requirement(seen, revision)
                except ParseError as error:
                    result.problems.append(f"{seen.requirement_id}: {error}")
                    continue
                by_id.setdefault(req.requirement_id, req)
        result.requirements = sorted(by_id.values(), key=lambda r: calc.position_key(r.requirement_id))
        result.seconds = round(time.monotonic() - started, 1)
        self.spec = result
        for req in result.requirements:
            self._requirement_found(req, site_id, pages[0].url if pages else "", site.seen, None)
        for problem in result.problems:
            self.board.problem("specification", problem)
        self.trace.event(site_id, "spec_done", seconds=result.seconds, revision=revision,
                         requirements=[r.requirement_id for r in result.requirements], pages=len(pages))

    async def _choose_revision(self, page: Page) -> CurrentRevision | None:
        text = page.text
        # thinking off: the status is written next to each revision; thinking on once wrote 17k tokens (68 s)
        agent = Agent(llm.model(), output_type=CurrentRevision, instructions=REVISION_INSTRUCTIONS,
                      model_settings=llm.settings(False), retries=3)

        @agent.output_validator
        def _shown(out: CurrentRevision) -> CurrentRevision:
            if not out.revision.strip() or out.revision.strip() not in text:
                raise ModelRetry("Give the revision exactly as the page shows it.")
            return out

        try:
            return (await agent.run(f"Tender {self.reference}. The specification page:\n{text[:20000]}")).output
        except Exception as error:
            self.trace.event("specification", "revision_failed", error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:160]}")
            return None

    async def erp_http(self, site_id: str) -> ErpResearch:
        site = self.sites[site_id]
        started = time.monotonic()
        await self.home(site_id)
        home = await site.get(site.base, fresh=True)  # as it is now (the session may have ended while it waited)
        groups: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
        for rid, req in self.requirements.items():
            groups.setdefault(req.catalog_group, []).append(rid)
        nav = Navigator(site, ERP_SEARCH_GOAL.format(groups=", ".join(groups)),
                        {g: f"the search result list of catalogue group {g}" for g in groups},
                        deadline=self._deadline(), name=f"{site_id}:search")
        kept = await nav.run([home])
        reports = await asyncio.gather(*(self._search_report(g, kept.get(g) or []) for g in groups))
        research: dict[str, RequirementResearch] = {}
        links: dict[str, str] = {}
        for group, report in zip(groups, reports):
            for rid in groups[group]:
                out = RequirementResearch(requirement_id=rid, search_term=report.search_term if report else group)
                if report is None:
                    out.problems.append("no search result list read")
                else:
                    out.candidates = [Candidate(material_number=c.material_number.strip(), link=c.link.strip(),
                                                bore=_num(c.bore), stroke=_num(c.stroke), pressure=_num(c.pressure),
                                                mounting=c.mounting, certification=c.certification)
                                      for c in report.candidates]
                    out.inspected = list(dict.fromkeys(c.material_number for c in out.candidates))
                    # an empty group only when the site itself says so on a list kept for it (rule 3 makes that a
                    # no_bid); a list that merely shows no rows is a gap
                    out.no_hits = not out.candidates and any(NO_HITS.search(p.text) for p in kept.get(group) or [])
                    if not out.candidates and not out.no_hits:
                        out.problems.append("search list shows no hits of the group and no no-hits notice")
                    for c in out.candidates:
                        links.setdefault(c.material_number, c.link)
                research[rid] = out
        numbers = list(links)
        materials = {}
        if numbers:
            listing = ", ".join(f"{n} (record: {links[n]})" for n in numbers)
            nav2 = Navigator(site, ERP_DETAIL_GOAL.format(materials=listing), {n: f"the views of material {n}"
                                                                              for n in numbers},
                             deadline=self._deadline(), name=f"{site_id}:materials")
            start = [p for g in groups for p in (kept.get(g) or [])] or [home]
            views = await nav2.run(start)
            for n in numbers:  # pages the navigator read that name the material count too (kept or not)
                mine = [p for p in nav2.shown if n in p.url or (n in p.text and p not in start)]
                views[n] = _dedupe(views.get(n, []) + [p for p in mine if p not in views.get(n, [])])
            reads = await asyncio.gather(*(self._material(n, views[n], site_id) for n in numbers))
            materials = {n: r for n, r in zip(numbers, reads) if r is not None}
        self.trace.event(site_id, "erp_done", seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 1),
                         hits={g: [c.material_number for c in research[groups[g][0]].candidates] for g in groups},
                         read=sorted(materials))
        return ErpResearch(requirements=list(research.values()), materials=materials,
                           seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 1))

    async def _search_report(self, group: str, pages: list[Page]) -> SearchReport | None:
        if not pages:
            return None
        text = "\n\n".join(p.view() for p in _dedupe(pages))
        agent = Agent(llm.model(), output_type=SearchReport, instructions=SEARCH_INSTRUCTIONS,
                      model_settings=llm.settings(False), retries=3)

        @agent.output_validator
        def _grounded(out: SearchReport) -> SearchReport:
            missing = [c.material_number for c in out.candidates if c.material_number.strip() not in text]
            if missing:
                raise ModelRetry(f"{missing} are not on the pages; copy the material numbers exactly.")
            return out

        try:
            return (await agent.run(f"Catalogue group {group}. Search result pages:\n{text}")).output
        except Exception as error:
            self.board.problem("materials", f"{group}: search list not read ({type(error).__name__})")
            return None

    async def _material(self, number: str, pages: list[Page], site_id: str):
        if not pages:
            return None
        corpus = "\n\n".join(f"=== {_host_path(p.url)}\n{p.text}" for p in pages)
        try:
            seen = await _read_material(number, corpus, self.trace, f"{site_id}:{number}")
        except Exception as error:
            self.board.problem("materials", f"{number}: not read ({type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:120]})")
            return None
        record = _material_record(seen)
        missing = incomplete(record)
        if missing:
            record.problems.append(f"missing: {', '.join(missing)}")
        return record

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ mails

    async def mails_http(self, site_id: str, plan: asyncio.Task) -> None:
        site = self.sites[site_id]
        try:
            kinds = await plan
        except Exception as error:
            self.board.problem("mails", f"plan failed: {type(error).__name__}")
            self.board.finish("mail")
            return
        self.mail_kinds = [k for k in kinds if k.site == site_id]
        self.mail_sessions = [_SiteView(site)]
        home = await self.home(site_id)
        listing = "\n".join(f"- {k.name}: {k.what}" for k in self.mail_kinds)
        # 1. the model searches every folder for each record kind and keeps the result lists
        nav = Navigator(site, MAIL_SEARCH_GOAL.format(reference=self.reference, kinds=listing),
                        {k.name: f"the search result lists (every folder, all pages) for: {k.what}"
                         for k in self.mail_kinds}, deadline=self._deadline(), name=f"{site_id}:mail", rounds=4)
        lists = await nav.run([home])
        # 2. one decision over all result rows: which messages are the records (exact reference, right subject)
        chosen = await self._choose_messages(lists)
        targets = sorted({t for ts in chosen.values() for t in ts})
        opened = dict(zip(targets, await asyncio.gather(*(site.get(t) for t in targets), return_exceptions=True)))
        kept = {k: [opened[t] for t in ts if isinstance(opened.get(t), Page)] for k, ts in chosen.items()}
        self.trace.event(site_id, "mail_chosen", chosen={k: len(v) for k, v in chosen.items()},
                         opened=sum(isinstance(p, Page) for p in opened.values()))
        started = time.monotonic()

        async def kind(k) -> None:
            pages = _dedupe(kept.get(k.name) or [])
            records = await asyncio.gather(*(research_mail.read_message(p.view(), k, self.reference) for p in pages))
            self.mail_results[k.name] = research_mail.KindResult(
                kind=k, kept=[p.view() for p in pages], records=[r for r in records if r is not None],
                seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 1))
            self.trace.event(site_id, "mail_kind", record_kind=k.name, kept=len(pages),
                             records=[{"subject": r.subject, "sender": r.sender, "sent": str(r.sent_at)}
                                      for r in records if r is not None][:6])

        await asyncio.gather(*(kind(k) for k in self.mail_kinds))
        self.mailbox = await research_mail.mailbox_address(_SiteView(site))
        await self._resolve_mail(self.mailbox)
        self.board.finish("mail")

    async def _choose_messages(self, lists: dict[str, list[Page]]) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
        """The model picks, per record kind, the result rows that are that record for the exact reference."""
        rows: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
        allowed: set[str] = set()
        for name, pages in lists.items():
            lines = []
            for page in _dedupe(pages):
                for line in page.text.splitlines():
                    links = LINK_RE.findall(line)
                    if links and not all(NEXT.search(t) or NOT_NEXT.search(t) for t, _ in links):
                        lines.append(line.strip())
                        allowed.update(self.sites[self.mail_sessions[0].name].url(h, page.url)
                                       for _, h in LINK_RE.findall(line))
            rows[name] = list(dict.fromkeys(lines))[:60]
        if not any(rows.values()):
            return {}
        what = {k.name: k.what for k in self.mail_kinds}
        text = "\n\n".join(f"## {name}: {what.get(name, '')}\n" + ("\n".join(r) or "(no rows)")
                           for name, r in rows.items())
        site = self.sites[self.mail_sessions[0].name]
        agent = Agent(llm.model(), output_type=MessageChoice, instructions=CHOOSE_MESSAGES,
                      model_settings=llm.settings(False), retries=3)

        @agent.output_validator
        def _shown(out: MessageChoice) -> MessageChoice:
            bad = [t for c in out.choices for t in c.targets if site.url(t) not in allowed]
            unknown = [c.kind for c in out.choices if c.kind not in rows]
            if bad or unknown:
                raise ModelRetry(f"Use link targets exactly as the rows show them ({bad[:5]} are not) and the kinds "
                                 f"{sorted(rows)} ({unknown} are not).")
            return out

        try:
            out = (await agent.run(f"Tender {self.reference} (exactly this reference). Result rows per record kind:"
                                   f"\n\n{text}")).output
        except Exception as error:
            self.board.problem("mails", f"message choice failed: {type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:120]}")
            return {}
        chosen: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
        for c in out.choices:
            chosen.setdefault(c.kind, []).extend(t for t in c.targets if t not in chosen.get(c.kind, []))
        return chosen

1	"""
2	The research over plain HTTP (AGENT_HTTP=1): the same facts, readers, rules and calc as the browser path, with the
3	browsing done by http_nav.Navigator on http_site.HttpSite instead of step-by-step browser workers.
4	
5	Per website a model navigates in a few large steps (it sees whole pages as text and asks for every page, search or
6	form it needs next at once) and names the pages that hold each kind of fact; the existing readers then extract the
7	facts from those pages (tender positions and Q&A, specification pages, ERP material views, messages), and the
8	orchestrator's verify / select / calc / gap logic runs unchanged on them (HttpOrchestrator subclasses it).
9	
10	  brief -> plan (which website holds what) + mail plan (record kinds)
11	        -> tender: positions + Q&A          -> specification: current revision + requirements
12	        -> mails: record kinds              -> ERP: group searches -> material views
13	  readers -> board -> verify / select / calc -> answer for the bid form (browser, submit.py)
14	
15	Nothing here names a site, a label, a path or a value of any dataset: the goals describe roles and facts.
16	"""

256	            p for p in reversed(nav.shown) if len(re.findall(r"revision", p.text, re.I)) >= 3][:1]
257	        if not history:
258	            self.board.problem("specification", "no revision history found")
259	            return
260	        choice = await self._choose_revision(history[-1])
261	        if choice is None:
262	            self.board.problem("specification", "no current revision chosen")
263	            return
264	        revision = choice.revision.strip()
265	        self.trace.event(site_id, "spec_revision", revision=revision, why=choice.why)
266	        # every requirement page of that revision: a short navigation from what was read (it may be done at once)
267	        seen = [p for p in kept["requirements"] if revision in p.text]
268	        nav2 = Navigator(site, SPEC_PAGES_GOAL.format(revision=revision),
269	                         {"requirements": f"every requirement page of revision {revision}"},
270	                         deadline=self._deadline(), name=f"{site_id}:spec-pages", rounds=4)
271	        more = await nav2.run(_dedupe(history[-1:] + seen))
272	        pages = _dedupe([p for p in more["requirements"] + seen if revision in p.text])
273	        context = f"Tender reference: {self.reference}"
274	        extracted = await asyncio.gather(*(_extract_page(p.text, choice.document, revision, context, self.trace,
275	                                                         site_id) for p in pages))
276	        result = SpecResult(document=choice.document, current_revision=revision)
277	        by_id = {}
278	        for page in extracted:
279	            if page is None:

281	                continue
282	            if page.revision_shown and not same_revision(page.revision_shown, revision):

284	            for seen in page.requirements:

296	        for problem in result.problems:
