"""
The research over plain HTTP (AGENT_HTTP=1): the same facts, readers, rules and calc as the browser path, with the
browsing done by http_nav.Navigator on http_site.HttpSite instead of step-by-step browser workers.

Per website a model navigates in a few large steps (it sees whole pages as text and asks for every page, search or
form it needs next at once) and names the pages that hold each kind of fact; the existing readers then extract the
facts from those pages (tender positions and Q&A, specification pages, ERP material views, messages), and the
orchestrator's verify / select / calc / gap logic runs unchanged on them (HttpOrchestrator subclasses it).

  brief -> plan (which website holds what) + mail plan (record kinds)
        -> tender: positions + Q&A          -> specification: current revision + requirements
        -> mails: record kinds              -> ERP: group searches -> material views
  readers -> board -> verify / select / calc -> answer for the bid form (browser, submit.py)

Nothing here names a site, a label, a path or a value of any dataset: the goals describe roles and facts.
"""
import asyncio
import re
import time
from urllib.parse import urlparse

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from pydantic_ai import Agent, ModelRetry

import calc
import llm
import research_mail
import research_tender
from briefing import Briefing
from evidence import Candidate, ParseError, RequirementResearch, SpecResult
from http_nav import Navigator, _host_path
from http_site import LINK as LINK_RE
from http_site import NEXT, NOT_NEXT, HttpSite, Page
from site_tools import NO_HITS
from orchestrator import FACT_KINDS, Orchestrator, Plan, plan_research
from research import (ErpResearch, SearchReport, SpecPage, _extract_page, _material_record, _num,
                      _parse_requirement, _read_material, _read_settings, incomplete, same_revision)
from tracing import Trace

TENDER_GOAL = """\
Tender {reference} (exactly this reference; similar references are other tenders). Open this tender, its
documents and its bidder questions and answers. Keep the document(s) that list the tender's positions (position
numbers, short texts, original quantities and units, requirement references), and every page of the bidder
Q&A (follow the list through all its pages). Documents can be opened by their title link; the tender may need
no further action to be read."""

SPEC_GOAL = """\
The buyer's technical specification (requirement sheets) for tender {reference}: {title}. Find it (a document
register may hide each document's link behind an actions menu), open it, and if the site asks for a usage
confirmation before releasing it, choose the binding documents (archive copies and previews give no access) and
copy the number shown exactly. Keep the page that lists the document's revisions with their status (statuses may
be in tooltips), and the requirement pages of the revision marked as currently valid, if you see them."""

SPEC_PAGES_GOAL = """\
Read every page of the requirements of revision {revision} of the specification (only this revision; its
requirement pages may be paged or embedded as a frame: follow them through all pages)."""

ERP_SEARCH_GOAL = """\
In this ERP, search the material catalogue once for each of these catalogue groups, with the group code as the
search term: {groups}. Use the ERP's material search (search help), whose form searches descriptions or groups;
a field that takes one material number is not a search. If an entry check or notice shows first, get past it
(copy any number it shows exactly). Keep, per group, the search result list (all its pages), only once it lists
hits of that group or says it has none. Do not open the hits."""

ERP_DETAIL_GOAL = """\
Read the ERP views of each of these materials: {materials}. For each, open its record and every view that
shows: its status and the meaning of that status (a legend may sit in a tooltip); its technical data; its stock,
down to the view that separates freely usable from blocked stock; lead time from stock and production lead
time; pieces per carton, allocation weight, surcharge mass and metal/price index code; and EVERY price condition
record with its validity, currency, exchange-rate key, price unit and quantity scales (condition records may be
paged one per page; scales may sit in a sub-view of each record). Request the same views for all materials at
once. Keep each material's views under its number."""

MAIL_SEARCH_GOAL = """\
The bidder's mailbox. For tender {reference}, search every folder (e.g. inbox and archive) for each of these
records:
{kinds}
The mailbox search combines words with AND: search for the reference together with the record's subject word,
in each folder: one search per record and folder, all in one step (use each folder's search address). Keep each
search's result list under its record (all pages; also lists that show no hits). Do not open messages: they are
chosen from the lists afterwards. If a search shows nothing in any folder, try once with another word for the
topic. Signing TANs are not needed."""

CHOOSE_MESSAGES = """\
You choose messages to open from mailbox search results. For each record kind, pick every result row whose
subject names that record for exactly the given tender reference (a reference with any extra prefix or suffix,
like a trailing letter, is another tender), older and newer versions alike, from any folder; when unsure whether a
row is that record, include it. Give each row's link target exactly as shown. A kind without such a row gets
no targets."""


class KindChoice(BaseModel):
    kind: str
    targets: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Link targets of the rows to open, as shown")


class MessageChoice(BaseModel):
    choices: list[KindChoice] = Field(default_factory=list)

SEARCH_INSTRUCTIONS = """\
You read ERP search result pages and report the search term shown and every listed hit of the given catalogue
group with its link target and the technical attributes the list shows, exactly as written. If the pages list no
hit of that group, return an empty list of candidates."""

REVISION_INSTRUCTIONS = """\
You decide which revision of a buyer's specification governs a bid: the one the document marks as currently valid
(in whatever words the site uses, possibly only in a tooltip), never one marked as superseded, replaced or
withdrawn. Documents may list or open the oldest revision first, and dates may be written in different orders, so
go by the marked status; use dates only if no status marks one revision as current."""


class CurrentRevision(BaseModel):
    revision: str = Field(description="The revision the site marks as currently valid, exactly as shown")
    document: str = Field(description="The specification document's number or title as shown")
    why: str = Field(description="What marks it as current, in a few words")


def _views(pages: list[Page]) -> str:
    return "\n\n".join(p.view() for p in pages)


def _dedupe(pages: list[Page]) -> list[Page]:
    out, seen = [], set()
    for p in pages:
        if p.text not in seen:
            seen.add(p.text)
            out.append(p)
    return out


class _Here:
    """What _post_tender and similar helpers read from a session: the page it is on."""
    def __init__(self, url: str):
        self.url = url


class HttpOrchestrator(Orchestrator):
    """The orchestrator with HTTP research; verify, material choice, calc and the answer are the base class's."""

    def __init__(self, task: dict, briefing: Briefing, trace: Trace, deadline: float,
                 sites: dict[str, HttpSite], starts: dict[str, asyncio.Task]):
        super().__init__(task, briefing, {}, trace, deadline)
        self.sites, self.starts = sites, starts
        self.http_plan: Plan | None = None  # self.plan stays None: the browser gap retries do not apply here
        self.http_seconds: dict[str, float] = {}

    async def home(self, site: str) -> Page:
        page = await self.starts[site]
        return page

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ the pipeline

    async def research(self) -> None:
        started = time.monotonic()
        sites = {s["siteId"]: s["url"] for s in self.task["access"]}
        mail_plan = asyncio.create_task(research_mail.plan_searches(self.task["brief"], sites))
        self.http_plan = await plan_research(self.task, self.briefing)
        self.trace.event("plan", "done", needs=[f"{n.kind}@{n.site}" for n in self.http_plan.needs])
        where: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
        for n in self.http_plan.needs:
            if n.site in self.sites and n.site not in where.setdefault(n.kind, []):
                where[n.kind].append(n.site)
        jobs = [asyncio.create_task(self._timed(self.tender(s), f"tender@{s}")) for s in where.get("tender", [])[:1]]
        spec_sites, erp_sites = where.get("specification", []), where.get("materials", [])
        if spec_sites:
            jobs.append(asyncio.create_task(self._timed(
                self.specification_and_erp(spec_sites[0], erp_sites[0] if erp_sites else None), "spec+erp")))
        jobs += [asyncio.create_task(self._timed(self.mails_http(s, mail_plan), f"mails@{s}"))
                 for s in where.get("mails", [])[:1]]
        done, pending = await asyncio.wait(jobs, timeout=max(1.0, self.left()))
        for job in pending:
            job.cancel()
            self.board.problem("deadline", f"{job.get_name()} stopped at the research deadline")
        if pending:
            await asyncio.gather(*pending, return_exceptions=True)
        if not mail_plan.done():
            mail_plan.cancel()
        self.trace.event("http", "research_done", seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 1),
                         parts=self.http_seconds,
                         requests={n: s.requests for n, s in self.sites.items()})

    async def _timed(self, coro, name: str) -> None:
        began = time.monotonic()
        try:
            await coro
        except Exception as error:
            self.board.problem(name, f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}")
            self.trace.event("http", "part_failed", part=name, error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}")
        finally:
            self.http_seconds[name] = round(time.monotonic() - began, 1)

    def _deadline(self) -> float:
        return self.research_deadline - 30

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ tender

    async def tender(self, site_id: str) -> None:
        site = self.sites[site_id]
        started = time.monotonic()
        home = await self.home(site_id)
        nav = Navigator(site, TENDER_GOAL.format(reference=self.reference),
                        {"positions": "the document(s) listing the positions with original quantities and units",
                         "qa": "every page of the bidder questions and answers"},
                        deadline=self._deadline(), name=f"{site_id}:tender")
        kept = await nav.run([home])
        docs = _dedupe(kept["positions"])
        qa = _dedupe(kept["qa"])
        positions_text = _views(docs) or site.seen
        positions, records = await asyncio.gather(
            research_tender.read_positions(positions_text, self.reference),
            research_tender.read_qa([p.view() for p in qa], self.reference) if qa else _no_qa())
        site_view = _SiteView(site)
        facts = research_tender._finish(site_view, positions, records, bool(qa), self.scenario, started, None)
        if facts is None:
            self.board.problem("tender", "no positions and no Q&A read")
            return
        self.tender_facts = facts
        self.tender_reads[site_id] = facts
        self._post_tender(facts, site_id, site_view)
        self.board.finish("position")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ specification, then ERP

    async def specification_and_erp(self, spec_site: str, erp_site: str | None) -> None:
        erp_ready = asyncio.create_task(self.home(erp_site)) if erp_site else None
        try:
            await self.specification_http(spec_site)
        finally:
            self.board.finish("requirement")
        if erp_site is None or not self.requirements:
            self.board.finish("material")
            return
        if erp_ready is not None:
            await erp_ready
        try:
            self.erp = await self.erp_http(erp_site)
            await self._post_materials(erp_site)
        finally:
            self.board.finish("material")

    async def specification_http(self, site_id: str) -> None:
        site = self.sites[site_id]
        started = time.monotonic()
        home = await self.home(site_id)
        title = self.task["brief"].split("\n\n")[1][:300] if "\n\n" in self.task["brief"] else ""
        nav = Navigator(site, SPEC_GOAL.format(reference=self.reference, title=title),
                        {"history": "the page listing the specification's revisions with their status",
                         "requirements": "requirement pages of the currently valid revision (all pages)"},
                        deadline=self._deadline(), name=f"{site_id}:spec")
        kept = await nav.run([home])
        # the newest version of each kept history page (a confirmation or a new sign-in changes what a page shows),
        # else the newest page read that lists revisions
        newest = {p.url: p for p in nav.shown}
        history = [newest.get(p.url, p) for p in kept["history"]]
        history = [p for p in history if len(re.findall(r"revision", p.text, re.I)) >= 2] or [
            p for p in reversed(nav.shown) if len(re.findall(r"revision", p.text, re.I)) >= 3][:1]
        if not history:
            self.board.problem("specification", "no revision history found")
            return
        choice = await self._choose_revision(history[-1])
        if choice is None:
            self.board.problem("specification", "no current revision chosen")
            return
        revision = choice.revision.strip()
        self.trace.event(site_id, "spec_revision", revision=revision, why=choice.why)
        # every requirement page of that revision: a short navigation from what was read (it may be done at once)
        seen = [p for p in kept["requirements"] if revision in p.text]
        nav2 = Navigator(site, SPEC_PAGES_GOAL.format(revision=revision),
                         {"requirements": f"every requirement page of revision {revision}"},
                         deadline=self._deadline(), name=f"{site_id}:spec-pages", rounds=4)
        more = await nav2.run(_dedupe(history[-1:] + seen))
        pages = _dedupe([p for p in more["requirements"] + seen if revision in p.text])
        context = f"Tender reference: {self.reference}"
        extracted = await asyncio.gather(*(_extract_page(p.text, choice.document, revision, context, self.trace,
                                                         site_id) for p in pages))
        result = SpecResult(document=choice.document, current_revision=revision)
        by_id = {}
        for page in extracted:
            if page is None:
                result.problems.append("a document page could not be extracted")
                continue
            if page.revision_shown and not same_revision(page.revision_shown, revision):
                continue
            for seen in page.requirements:
                try:
                    req = _parse_requirement(seen, revision)
                except ParseError as error:
                    result.problems.append(f"{seen.requirement_id}: {error}")
                    continue
                by_id.setdefault(req.requirement_id, req)
        result.requirements = sorted(by_id.values(), key=lambda r: calc.position_key(r.requirement_id))
        result.seconds = round(time.monotonic() - started, 1)
        self.spec = result
        for req in result.requirements:
            self._requirement_found(req, site_id, pages[0].url if pages else "", site.seen, None)
        for problem in result.problems:
            self.board.problem("specification", problem)
        self.trace.event(site_id, "spec_done", seconds=result.seconds, revision=revision,
                         requirements=[r.requirement_id for r in result.requirements], pages=len(pages))

    async def _choose_revision(self, page: Page) -> CurrentRevision | None:
        text = page.text
        # thinking off: the status is written next to each revision; thinking on once wrote 17k tokens (68 s)
        agent = Agent(llm.model(), output_type=CurrentRevision, instructions=REVISION_INSTRUCTIONS,
                      model_settings=llm.settings(False), retries=3)

        @agent.output_validator
        def _shown(out: CurrentRevision) -> CurrentRevision:
            if not out.revision.strip() or out.revision.strip() not in text:
                raise ModelRetry("Give the revision exactly as the page shows it.")
            return out

        try:
            return (await agent.run(f"Tender {self.reference}. The specification page:\n{text[:20000]}")).output
        except Exception as error:
            self.trace.event("specification", "revision_failed", error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:160]}")
            return None

    async def erp_http(self, site_id: str) -> ErpResearch:
        site = self.sites[site_id]
        started = time.monotonic()
        await self.home(site_id)
        home = await site.get(site.base, fresh=True)  # as it is now (the session may have ended while it waited)
        groups: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
        for rid, req in self.requirements.items():
            groups.setdefault(req.catalog_group, []).append(rid)
        nav = Navigator(site, ERP_SEARCH_GOAL.format(groups=", ".join(groups)),
                        {g: f"the search result list of catalogue group {g}" for g in groups},
                        deadline=self._deadline(), name=f"{site_id}:search")
        kept = await nav.run([home])
        reports = await asyncio.gather(*(self._search_report(g, kept.get(g) or []) for g in groups))
        research: dict[str, RequirementResearch] = {}
        links: dict[str, str] = {}
        for group, report in zip(groups, reports):
            for rid in groups[group]:
                out = RequirementResearch(requirement_id=rid, search_term=report.search_term if report else group)
                if report is None:
                    out.problems.append("no search result list read")
                else:
                    out.candidates = [Candidate(material_number=c.material_number.strip(), link=c.link.strip(),
                                                bore=_num(c.bore), stroke=_num(c.stroke), pressure=_num(c.pressure),
                                                mounting=c.mounting, certification=c.certification)
                                      for c in report.candidates]
                    out.inspected = list(dict.fromkeys(c.material_number for c in out.candidates))
                    # an empty group only when the site itself says so on a list kept for it (rule 3 makes that a
                    # no_bid); a list that merely shows no rows is a gap
                    out.no_hits = not out.candidates and any(NO_HITS.search(p.text) for p in kept.get(group) or [])
                    if not out.candidates and not out.no_hits:
                        out.problems.append("search list shows no hits of the group and no no-hits notice")
                    for c in out.candidates:
                        links.setdefault(c.material_number, c.link)
                research[rid] = out
        numbers = list(links)
        materials = {}
        if numbers:
            listing = ", ".join(f"{n} (record: {links[n]})" for n in numbers)
            nav2 = Navigator(site, ERP_DETAIL_GOAL.format(materials=listing), {n: f"the views of material {n}"
                                                                              for n in numbers},
                             deadline=self._deadline(), name=f"{site_id}:materials")
            start = [p for g in groups for p in (kept.get(g) or [])] or [home]
            views = await nav2.run(start)
            for n in numbers:  # pages the navigator read that name the material count too (kept or not)
                mine = [p for p in nav2.shown if n in p.url or (n in p.text and p not in start)]
                views[n] = _dedupe(views.get(n, []) + [p for p in mine if p not in views.get(n, [])])
            reads = await asyncio.gather(*(self._material(n, views[n], site_id) for n in numbers))
            materials = {n: r for n, r in zip(numbers, reads) if r is not None}
        self.trace.event(site_id, "erp_done", seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 1),
                         hits={g: [c.material_number for c in research[groups[g][0]].candidates] for g in groups},
                         read=sorted(materials))
        return ErpResearch(requirements=list(research.values()), materials=materials,
                           seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 1))

    async def _search_report(self, group: str, pages: list[Page]) -> SearchReport | None:
        if not pages:
            return None
        text = "\n\n".join(p.view() for p in _dedupe(pages))
        agent = Agent(llm.model(), output_type=SearchReport, instructions=SEARCH_INSTRUCTIONS,
                      model_settings=llm.settings(False), retries=3)

        @agent.output_validator
        def _grounded(out: SearchReport) -> SearchReport:
            missing = [c.material_number for c in out.candidates if c.material_number.strip() not in text]
            if missing:
                raise ModelRetry(f"{missing} are not on the pages; copy the material numbers exactly.")
            return out

        try:
            return (await agent.run(f"Catalogue group {group}. Search result pages:\n{text}")).output
        except Exception as error:
            self.board.problem("materials", f"{group}: search list not read ({type(error).__name__})")
            return None

    async def _material(self, number: str, pages: list[Page], site_id: str):
        if not pages:
            return None
        corpus = "\n\n".join(f"=== {_host_path(p.url)}\n{p.text}" for p in pages)
        try:
            seen = await _read_material(number, corpus, self.trace, f"{site_id}:{number}")
        except Exception as error:
            self.board.problem("materials", f"{number}: not read ({type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:120]})")
            return None
        record = _material_record(seen)
        missing = incomplete(record)
        if missing:
            record.problems.append(f"missing: {', '.join(missing)}")
        return record

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ mails

    async def mails_http(self, site_id: str, plan: asyncio.Task) -> None:
        site = self.sites[site_id]
        try:
            kinds = await plan
        except Exception as error:
            self.board.problem("mails", f"plan failed: {type(error).__name__}")
            self.board.finish("mail")
            return
        self.mail_kinds = [k for k in kinds if k.site == site_id]
        self.mail_sessions = [_SiteView(site)]
        home = await self.home(site_id)
        listing = "\n".join(f"- {k.name}: {k.what}" for k in self.mail_kinds)
        # 1. the model searches every folder for each record kind and keeps the result lists
        nav = Navigator(site, MAIL_SEARCH_GOAL.format(reference=self.reference, kinds=listing),
                        {k.name: f"the search result lists (every folder, all pages) for: {k.what}"
                         for k in self.mail_kinds}, deadline=self._deadline(), name=f"{site_id}:mail", rounds=4)
        lists = await nav.run([home])
        # 2. one decision over all result rows: which messages are the records (exact reference, right subject)
        chosen = await self._choose_messages(lists)
        targets = sorted({t for ts in chosen.values() for t in ts})
        opened = dict(zip(targets, await asyncio.gather(*(site.get(t) for t in targets), return_exceptions=True)))
        kept = {k: [opened[t] for t in ts if isinstance(opened.get(t), Page)] for k, ts in chosen.items()}
        self.trace.event(site_id, "mail_chosen", chosen={k: len(v) for k, v in chosen.items()},
                         opened=sum(isinstance(p, Page) for p in opened.values()))
        started = time.monotonic()

        async def kind(k) -> None:
            pages = _dedupe(kept.get(k.name) or [])
            records = await asyncio.gather(*(research_mail.read_message(p.view(), k, self.reference) for p in pages))
            self.mail_results[k.name] = research_mail.KindResult(
                kind=k, kept=[p.view() for p in pages], records=[r for r in records if r is not None],
                seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 1))
            self.trace.event(site_id, "mail_kind", record_kind=k.name, kept=len(pages),
                             records=[{"subject": r.subject, "sender": r.sender, "sent": str(r.sent_at)}
                                      for r in records if r is not None][:6])

        await asyncio.gather(*(kind(k) for k in self.mail_kinds))
        self.mailbox = await research_mail.mailbox_address(_SiteView(site))
        await self._resolve_mail(self.mailbox)
        self.board.finish("mail")

    async def _choose_messages(self, lists: dict[str, list[Page]]) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
        """The model picks, per record kind, the result rows that are that record for the exact reference."""
        rows: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
        allowed: set[str] = set()
        for name, pages in lists.items():
            lines = []
            for page in _dedupe(pages):
                for line in page.text.splitlines():
                    links = LINK_RE.findall(line)
                    if links and not all(NEXT.search(t) or NOT_NEXT.search(t) for t, _ in links):
                        lines.append(line.strip())
                        allowed.update(self.sites[self.mail_sessions[0].name].url(h, page.url)
                                       for _, h in LINK_RE.findall(line))
            rows[name] = list(dict.fromkeys(lines))[:60]
        if not any(rows.values()):
            return {}
        what = {k.name: k.what for k in self.mail_kinds}
        text = "\n\n".join(f"## {name}: {what.get(name, '')}\n" + ("\n".join(r) or "(no rows)")
                           for name, r in rows.items())
        site = self.sites[self.mail_sessions[0].name]
        agent = Agent(llm.model(), output_type=MessageChoice, instructions=CHOOSE_MESSAGES,
                      model_settings=llm.settings(False), retries=3)

        @agent.output_validator
        def _shown(out: MessageChoice) -> MessageChoice:
            bad = [t for c in out.choices for t in c.targets if site.url(t) not in allowed]
            unknown = [c.kind for c in out.choices if c.kind not in rows]
            if bad or unknown:
                raise ModelRetry(f"Use link targets exactly as the rows show them ({bad[:5]} are not) and the kinds "
                                 f"{sorted(rows)} ({unknown} are not).")
            return out

        try:
            out = (await agent.run(f"Tender {self.reference} (exactly this reference). Result rows per record kind:"
                                   f"\n\n{text}")).output
        except Exception as error:
            self.board.problem("mails", f"message choice failed: {type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:120]}")
            return {}
        chosen: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
        for c in out.choices:
            chosen.setdefault(c.kind, []).extend(t for t in c.targets if t not in chosen.get(c.kind, []))
        return chosen


class _SiteView:
    """The parts of a browser session that the shared helpers read (name, trace, seen text, current page)."""

    def __init__(self, site: HttpSite):
        self._site = site
        self.site = site.site
        self.name = site.name
        self.trace = site.trace

    @property
    def seen(self) -> str:
        return self._site.seen

    @property
    def view(self) -> str:
        return self._site.view

    @property
    def page(self) -> _Here:
        return _Here(self._site.home.url if self._site.home else self._site.base)


class HttpMailbox:
    """
    The bidder's webmail for the bid form (submit.Mailbox's interface) read over HTTP: the signing TAN and the own
    address. A navigator finds the TAN message the model judges to be the one just requested; one reader call
    copies the TAN from that message (it must appear in it).
    """

    def __init__(self, site: HttpSite, briefing: Briefing, deadline: float):
        self.site, self.briefing, self.deadline = site, briefing, deadline
        self.lock = asyncio.Lock()
        self.last_tan = ""

    async def address(self) -> str:
        try:
            if self.site.home is None:
                await self.site.start()
            return await research_mail.mailbox_address(_SiteView(self.site))
        except Exception as error:
            self.site.trace.event(self.site.name, "stopped", reason=f"address: {type(error).__name__}: {error}")
            return ""

    async def tan(self, answer: str = ""):
        from submit import SigningTan, tan_goal
        older = f" The TAN {self.last_tan} you returned before is no longer valid." if self.last_tan else ""
        said = (f" The bid website answered the request with: {answer!r}; pick the message for that request."
                if answer else "")
        async with self.lock:
            for attempt in range(2):
                try:
                    self.site.pages.clear()  # the mailbox changed since anything was read: read it anew
                    home = await self.site.get(self.site.base, fresh=True)
                    nav = Navigator(self.site, tan_goal(self.briefing.tender_reference, said, older)
                                    + " Keep the opened message that shows that TAN.",
                                    {"tan": "the opened message with the TAN of the request just made"},
                                    deadline=self.deadline, name=f"{self.site.name}:tan", rounds=4)
                    kept = await nav.run([home])
                    pages = kept["tan"] or nav.shown[-1:]
                    text = "\n\n".join(p.view() for p in pages)
                    agent = Agent(llm.model(), output_type=SigningTan, model_settings=llm.settings(False), retries=3,
                                  instructions="You copy a signing TAN from the opened message, exactly as written.")

                    @agent.output_validator
                    def _shown(out):
                        if not out.tan.strip() or out.tan.strip() not in text:
                            raise ModelRetry("Copy the TAN exactly as the message shows it.")
                        return out

                    found = (await agent.run(f"{tan_goal(self.briefing.tender_reference, said, older)}\n\n"
                                             f"Pages:\n{text[:30000]}")).output
                    self.last_tan = found.tan
                    self.site.trace.event(self.site.name, "tan_found", subject=found.subject, attempt=attempt + 1)
                    return found
                except Exception as error:
                    self.site.trace.event(self.site.name, "stopped", reason=f"tan: {type(error).__name__}: {error}")
                    if self.deadline - time.monotonic() < 60:
                        return None
            return None


async def _no_qa():
    return research_tender.QaRecords()


def start_sites(task: dict, trace: Trace) -> tuple[dict[str, HttpSite], dict[str, asyncio.Task]]:
    """Every website signed in over HTTP at once, in the background."""
    sites = {s["siteId"]: HttpSite(s, trace) for s in task["access"]}
    starts = {name: asyncio.create_task(site.start(), name=f"http-start@{name}") for name, site in sites.items()}
    for t in starts.values():
        t.add_done_callback(lambda t: t.cancelled() or t.exception())
    return sites, starts


async def research(task: dict, briefing: Briefing, trace: Trace, deadline: float,
                   sites: dict[str, HttpSite], starts: dict[str, asyncio.Task]):
    """(answer, attributes) for the bid form, as agent.research() returns them."""
    answer, attributes = None, None
    orchestrator = None
    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        orchestrator = HttpOrchestrator(task, briefing, trace, deadline, sites, starts)
        answer, _ = await orchestrator.run()
        attributes = orchestrator.attributes
    except Exception as error:
        trace.event("orchestrator", "failed", error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:300]}")
    if answer is None and orchestrator is not None:
        answer = orchestrator.fallback_answer()
    trace.event("orchestrator", "done", seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 1), answer=answer,
                attributes=attributes, problems=(orchestrator.board.problems[:30] if orchestrator else []))

"""Open and sign in (SiteSession.start: waits on a slow tab, retries with backoff until `until`)."""
    await session.start(until=until)
    return session

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the planner

FACT_KINDS = {
    "tender": "the tender itself: its notice and documents with the positions (bill of quantities: quantities, "
              "units, requirement ids)",
    # its own kind: the bidder Q&A can live on another website than the tender (e.g. the buyer's portal)
    "qa": "the bidder questions and answers / clarifications of the tender (quantity changes, withdrawn answers, "
          "scoped technical amendments, and per-position keys for condition groups, packaging, delivery "
          "commitments, setup pools and bonus plans), on whichever website publishes them",
    "specification": "the buyer's technical specification: which revision is current and the technical "
                     "requirement (attributes, catalogue group, pieces per set) per requirement id",
    "materials": "the bidder's own ERP: the materials of a catalogue group with status, stock, lead times, "
                 "pieces per carton, masses, metal index code and price conditions with quantity scales",
    "mails": "authority records in the bidder's own mailbox: discount approval, condition rules, metal index "
             "rates, stroke reserves, packaging tariffs, delivery commitments, exchange rates, setup pools, "
             "bonus plans",
}


class Need(BaseModel):
    kind: Literal[tuple(FACT_KINDS)] = Field(description="Which facts")  # type: ignore[valid-type]
    site: str = Field(description="siteId of the website that holds them")
    why: str = Field(description="One sentence: which bid rules need these facts")


class Plan(BaseModel):
    needs: list[Need] = Field(description="Every kind of fact the bid needs (each kind at least once), each with "
                                          "its website")


def complete_plan(plan: Plan, briefing: Briefing, ids: set[str]) -> tuple[Plan, list[str]]:
    """
    A plan that still lacks a fact kind after the model's retries: the tender goes to the bid website and the mails
    to the mailbox (both read from the brief); a missing specification or ERP goes to every website that holds no
    other kind. Returns the completed plan and what was filled in.
    """
    have = {n.kind for n in plan.needs}
    free = sorted(ids - {n.site for n in plan.needs} - {briefing.bid_site, briefing.mail_site})
    needs, filled = list(plan.needs), []
    for kind in FACT_KINDS:
        if kind in have:
            continue
        for site in ([briefing.bid_site] if kind in ("tender", "qa") else [briefing.mail_site] if kind == "mails"
                     else free):
            if site in ids:
                needs.append(Need(kind=kind, site=site, why="missing from the model's plan; filled in"))
                filled.append(f"{kind}@{site}")
    return Plan(needs=needs), filled

    async def session(self, site: str, tag: str = "") -> SiteSession:

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ workers

    async def _tender_watch(self, site: str, first: asyncio.Task) -> None:
        """
        The gap check that cannot wait for the end of research: every position, and so the whole answer, waits on
        the tender's positions. When none are read TENDER_WATCH_SECONDS after the tender research started (a
        reader call that keeps timing out held them for ten minutes in one sandbox run), a second tender attempt
        on fresh tabs runs alongside; whichever completes with positions first wins and the other is stopped.
        """
        started = time.monotonic()

        def read() -> bool:
            return bool(self.board.get("position")) or bool(getattr(self.tender_facts, "positions", None))

        # An attempt that ended without positions (soak run 83438e79: its worker hit the request limit at 58 s) is
        # retried at once, not only after the whole research.
        while not read() and not first.done() and time.monotonic() - started < TENDER_WATCH_SECONDS:
            await asyncio.sleep(min(2.0, max(0.01, TENDER_WATCH_SECONDS - (time.monotonic() - started))))
        if read() or self.left() < TENDER_RETRY_SECONDS:
            return
        self.trace.event("gaps", "gap", gap="tender/positions", reason="no positions read yet", early=True,
                         seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started))
        retry = asyncio.create_task(self.tender(site, "2"), name=f"tender2@{site}")
        pending = {first, retry}
        try:
            while pending:
                _, pending = await asyncio.wait(pending, return_when=asyncio.FIRST_COMPLETED)
                if getattr(self.tender_facts, "positions", None):
                    break
        finally:  # also at the research deadline: the retry is no job of research(), so it ends here
            for task in pending:
                task.cancel()
            if pending:
                await asyncio.gather(*pending, return_exceptions=True)
        if getattr(self.tender_facts, "positions", None):
            self.trace.event("gaps", "gap_filled", gap="tender/positions", early=True,
                             by="retry" if retry.done() and not retry.cancelled() else "first attempt")

    async def tender(self, site: str, attempt: str = "") -> None:
        board = self.board
        try:
            session, qa_session = await asyncio.gather(self.session(site, f"tender{attempt}"),
                                                       self.session(site, f"qa{attempt}"), return_exceptions=True)
            if isinstance(session, BaseException):
                if isinstance(qa_session, BaseException):
                    raise session
                session, qa_session = qa_session, None
            elif isinstance(qa_session, BaseException):
                board.problem("tender", f"no second tab ({type(qa_session).__name__}); one worker reads all")
                qa_session = None

            self.tender_calls += 1
            read = f"{site}#{self.tender_calls}{attempt}"

            def on_facts(facts) -> None:
                self._tender_read(read, facts, site, session)

            with_qa = site in self._qa_sites()
            options = {} if with_qa else {"with_qa": False}
            facts = await research_tender.research_tender(session, self.reference, self.scenario,
                                                          deadline=self.research_deadline, qa_session=qa_session,
                                                          on_facts=on_facts, **options)
            if facts is None:
                board.problem("tender", f"{site}: neither positions nor Q&A found")
                if with_qa:
                    await self._qa_elsewhere({site, *self.qa_planned})
                return
            if self.tender_reads.get(read) is not facts:  # in case the module did not report it
                on_facts(facts)
            if not facts.positions:
                board.problem("tender", f"{site}: no positions found (its Q&A is kept)")
            if with_qa and not research_tender._has_records(facts.qa):
                await self._qa_elsewhere({site, *self.qa_planned})
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            if self.tender_facts is not None:
                board.problem("tender", "stopped at the deadline: positions without the full Q&A are used")
            raise
        except Exception as error:
            board.problem("tender", f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}")
        finally:
            for kind in ("position", "amendment", "withdrawn"):
                board.finish(kind)

    async def qa(self, site: str, tag: str = "qa") -> bool:
        """
        The bidder Q&A on a website that does not hold the tender's positions; its answers join the tender reads
        (combine). Without any answer read there the other websites are tried (_qa_elsewhere). True when this
        website had answers.
        """
        try:
            found = await self._qa_read(site, tag)
        except Exception as error:
            self.board.problem("tender", f"Q&A on {site}: {type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:160]}")
            found = False
        if not found:
            await self._qa_elsewhere({site, *self.qa_planned})
        return found

    async def _qa_read(self, site: str, tag: str) -> bool:
        self.tender_calls += 1
        session = await self.session(site, f"{tag}{self.tender_calls}")
        facts = await research_tender.research_qa(session, self.reference, self.scenario,
                                                  deadline=self.research_deadline)
        if not research_tender._has_records(facts.qa):
            self.board.problem("tender", f"{site}: no bidder Q&A answers read")
            return False
        self._tender_read(f"{site}#{self.tender_calls}{tag}", facts, site, session)
        if site not in self.qa_found:
            self.qa_found.append(site)
        return True

    async def _qa_elsewhere(self, tried: set[str]) -> None:
        """
        No Q&A answer where the plan put the Q&A (in one eval the planner put it with the tender, but the buyer's
        website held it and the bid lost every Q&A fact): the other websites except the mailbox are read for it
        one after the other, the specification's first, until one has answers.
        """
        if self.qa_found or self.left() < TENDER_RETRY_SECONDS:
            return
        needs = getattr(self.plan, "needs", []) or []
        mail = {n.site for n in needs if n.kind == "mails"} | {self.briefing.mail_site}
        order = [n.site for n in needs if n.kind == "specification"] + [s["siteId"] for s in self.task["access"]]
        for site in dict.fromkeys(order):
            if (site in tried or site in self.qa_tried or site in mail or self.qa_found
                    or self.left() < TENDER_RETRY_SECONDS):
                continue
            self.qa_tried.add(site)
            self.trace.event("tender", "qa_elsewhere", site=site)
            try:
                if await self._qa_read(site, "qa-alt"):
                    return
            except Exception as error:
                self.board.problem("tender", f"Q&A on {site}: {type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:160]}")

    def _qa_sites(self) -> list[str]:
        """The websites the Q&A was read on, else where the plan put it."""
        return (list(getattr(self, "qa_found", [])) or list(getattr(self, "qa_planned", []))
                or self._tender_sites())

    def _tender_read(self, read: str, facts, site: str, session: SiteSession) -> None:
            facts.problems.append("mailbox address not found: no sender could be authorised")
        for problem in facts.problems:
            self.board.problem("mails", problem)
        self.mail_facts = facts
        site = self.mail_sessions[0].site["siteId"].split(":")[0]
        used = {}
        for s in getattr(facts, "sources", []):
            if s.used:
                used.setdefault(s.kind, []).append(f"{s.subject} | {s.sender} | {s.sent_at.isoformat()} | {s.reference}")
        def post(kind: str, key: str, value) -> None:
            self.board.post("mail", f"{kind}/{key}", value if isinstance(value, (str, int, float, dict, list))
                            else value.model_dump(mode="json") if hasattr(value, "model_dump") else str(value),
                            Source(site=site, quote="; ".join(used.get(kind, [])) or "(no record used)"), "mails")
        if facts.approval is not None:
            post("approval", "latest", facts.approval)
        for table, kind in (("discount_scopes", "condition_rules"), ("metal_indices", "metal_indices"),
                            ("end_reserves", "end_reserves"), ("packaging", "packaging"),
                            ("commitments", "commitments"), ("fx_rates", "fx"), ("fx_per_eur", "fx"),
                            ("setup_pools", "setup_pools"),
                            ("project_bonuses", "project_bonus")):
            for key, value in (getattr(facts, table, None) or {}).items():
                if table == "fx_per_eur":  # quoted the other way round; calc divides by it
                    value = {"currency_units_per_eur": str(value)}
                post(kind, key, [v.model_dump(mode="json") for v in value] if isinstance(value, list) else value)

    async def research(self) -> None:
        self.plan = await plan_research(self.task, self.briefing)
        self.trace.event("plan", "done", needs=[f"{n.kind}@{n.site}: {n.why}" for n in self.plan.needs])
        sites: dict[str, list[str]] = {}  # a role may be spread over several websites in another dataset
        for n in self.plan.needs:
            if n.site not in sites.setdefault(n.kind, []):
                sites[n.kind].append(n.site)
        jobs = []
        if "tender" in sites and research_tender is not None:
            self.qa_planned = list(sites.get("qa") or sites["tender"])
            for site in sites["tender"]:
                first = asyncio.create_task(self.tender(site), name=f"tender@{site}")
                jobs += [first, asyncio.create_task(self._tender_watch(site, first), name=f"tender-watch@{site}")]
            for site in self.qa_planned:  # the Q&A on a website of its own
                if site not in sites["tender"]:
                    jobs.append(asyncio.create_task(self.qa(site), name=f"qa@{site}"))
        elif "tender" in sites:
            self.board.problem("plan", "tender research module not available")
        erp_sites = sites.get("materials", [])
        if len(erp_sites) > 1:
            self.board.problem("plan", f"materials on several sites {erp_sites}; only the first is searched")
        for site in sites.get("specification", []):
            jobs.append(asyncio.create_task(self.specification(site, erp_sites[0] if erp_sites else None),
                                            name=f"specification@{site}"))
        if "mails" in sites and research_mail is not None:
            jobs += [asyncio.create_task(self.mails(site), name=f"mails@{site}") for site in sites["mails"]]
        elif "mails" in sites:
            self.board.problem("plan", "mail research module not available")
        if not jobs:
            return
        mail_jobs = {job for job in jobs if job.get_name().startswith("mails@")}
        pending = set(jobs)
        while pending:
            early = EARLY_NO_BID and not self.no_bid_checked and bool(mail_jobs)
            _, pending = await asyncio.wait(pending, timeout=max(1.0, min(self.left(), NO_BID_POLL) if early
                                                                  else self.left()))
            if self.left() <= 0:
                break
            if early and pending and pending <= mail_jobs:  # only the mail searches still run
                self.no_bid_checked = True
                try:
                    await asyncio.wait_for(self._early_no_bid(lambda: any(not j.done() for j in mail_jobs)),
                                           max(1.0, self.left()))
                except Exception as error:
                    self.board.problem("verify", f"early no_bid check: {type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:160]}")
        for job in pending:  # the deadline guard: whatever is complete goes on
            job.cancel()
            self.board.problem("deadline", f"{job.get_name()} stopped at the research deadline")
        if pending:
            await asyncio.gather(*pending, return_exceptions=True)
        if self._erp is not None:  # ERP workers still browsing would compete with the bid form for the browser
            for task in [*self._erp.tasks.values(), *self._erp.materials.values()]:

                so_far = getattr(self._erp, "so_far", None)
                self.erp = so_far() if so_far is not None else self._finished_erp()
        self.rework = {"mails": self._rework_mail}

FACT_KINDS = {
    "tender": "the tender itself: its notice and documents with the positions (bill of quantities: quantities, "
              "units, requirement ids)",
    # its own kind: the bidder Q&A can live on another website than the tender (e.g. the buyer's portal)
    "qa": "the bidder questions and answers / clarifications of the tender (quantity changes, withdrawn answers, "
          "scoped technical amendments, and per-position keys for condition groups, packaging, delivery "
          "commitments, setup pools and bonus plans), on whichever website publishes them",
    "specification": "the buyer's technical specification: which revision is current and the technical "
                     "requirement (attributes, catalogue group, pieces per set) per requirement id",
    "materials": "the bidder's own ERP: the materials of a catalogue group with status, stock, lead times, "
                 "pieces per carton, masses, metal index code and price conditions with quantity scales",
    "mails": "authority records in the bidder's own mailbox: discount approval, condition rules, metal index "
             "rates, stroke reserves, packaging tariffs, delivery commitments, exchange rates, setup pools, "
             "bonus plans",
}

    to the mailbox (both read from the brief); a missing specification or ERP goes to every website that holds no
    other kind. Returns the completed plan and what was filled in.
    """
    have = {n.kind for n in plan.needs}

    needs, filled = list(plan.needs), []

class FormField:
    name: str
    kind: str  # text, select, checkbox, radio, textarea, number, ...
    value: str  # the default the page sets (for a radio or checkbox: the value it sends when chosen)
    label: str
    options: list[tuple[str, str]] = field(default_factory=list)  # select: (value, text)
    checked: bool = False


@dataclass
class Form:
    method: str
    action: str
    hidden: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    fields: list[FormField] = field(default_factory=list)
    buttons: list[tuple[str, str, str]] = field(default_factory=list)  # (name, value, label) of submit buttons

    def data(self, values: dict[str, str], button: str = "") -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
        """
        What submitting the form sends: hidden fields, each field's given value (by name; a select also by its
        option text) or the page's default, checkboxes only when ticked, and the chosen submit button (by label
        or value; the only one, or none).
        """
        out = list(self.hidden.items())
        given = {k.strip(): str(v) for k, v in values.items()}
        done: set[str] = set()
        for f in self.fields:
            if f.kind in ("checkbox", "radio"):
                if f.name in given:
                    want = given[f.name]
                    on = want.casefold() in (f.value.casefold(), f.label.casefold()) or (
                        f.kind == "checkbox" and want.casefold() in ("on", "yes", "true", "1", "checked", "ja"))
                    if on and (f.kind == "checkbox" or f.name not in done):
                        out.append((f.name, f.value))
                        done.add(f.name)
                elif f.checked:
                    out.append((f.name, f.value))
                continue
            if f.name in done:
                continue
            value = given.get(f.name, f.value)
            if f.kind == "select" and f.options:
                by_text = {t.casefold(): v for v, t in f.options}
                value = value if value in {v for v, _ in f.options} else by_text.get(value.casefold(), value)
            out.append((f.name, value))
            done.add(f.name)
        chosen = None
        if button:
            want = button.strip().casefold()
            chosen = next((b for b in self.buttons if want in (b[2].casefold(), b[1].casefold(),
                                                               f"{b[0]}={b[1]}".casefold())), None)
        elif len(self.buttons) == 1:
            chosen = self.buttons[0]
        if chosen and chosen[0]:
            out.append((chosen[0], chosen[1]))
        return out


@dataclass
class HtmlView:
    title: str
    text: str
    frames: list[str]  # iframe sources, in order (fetched by the reader and put in place)
    links: list[str]
    forms: list[Form] = field(default_factory=list)  # numbered from 1 in the text: [form N METHOD -> action]


    gather(root)
    hider = Hider("\n".join(styles))
    out: list[str] = []
    frames: list[str] = []
    links: list[str] = []
    forms: list[Form] = []
    emit = out.append

    def _form(node: Node) -> "Form":
        a = node.attrs
        form = Form(method=a.get("method", "get").lower(), action=a.get("action", ""))
        for d in _descendants(node):
            name, kind = d.attrs.get("name", ""), d.attrs.get("type", "text").lower()
            if d.tag == "input" and kind == "hidden":
                if name:
                    form.hidden[name] = d.attrs.get("value", "")
            elif d.tag == "button" or (d.tag == "input" and kind in ("submit", "image")):
                if d.tag == "button" and kind not in ("submit", "") and d.attrs.get("type"):
                    continue  # type=button: a script control, it submits nothing
                form.buttons.append((name, d.attrs.get("value", ""),
                                     _clean(d.text()) or _clean(d.attrs.get("value", "")) or label_of(d)))
            elif d.tag == "select" and name:
                opts = [(o.attrs.get("value", _clean(o.text())), _clean(o.text()), "selected" in o.attrs)
                        for o in _descendants(d) if o.tag == "option"]
                form.fields.append(FormField(name, "select", next((v for v, _, s in opts if s), opts[0][0] if opts else ""),
                                         label_of(d), [(v, t) for v, t, _ in opts]))
            elif d.tag == "textarea" and name:
                form.fields.append(FormField(name, "textarea", _clean(d.text()), label_of(d)))
            elif d.tag == "input" and name and kind not in ("button", "reset"):
                form.fields.append(FormField(name, kind, d.attrs.get("value", "on" if kind in ("checkbox", "radio") else ""),
                                         label_of(d), checked="checked" in d.attrs))
        return form

    def effective(self, req: Requirement) -> EffectiveRequirement:
        return effective_requirement(req, amendments=self._amendments(), reserves=self._reserves(req.revision),
                                     scenario_date=self.scenario_stamp)

    async def specification(self, site: str, erp_site: str | None) -> None:
        """
        The specification, twice at once: a fast navigator (thinking off) and a careful one (thinking on, more
        steps) work in separate contexts of the website; the first that yields a revision with requirements wins
        and the other is cancelled. Requirements stream to the ERP as soon as either attempt reads them, all from
        one revision (the first one read); requirements read before an attempt stopped are kept.
        """
        board = self.board
        erp = None
        if erp_site:
            if self._erp is None:
                self._erp = Erp(self.access[erp_site], self.contexts[erp_site], self.trace, self.research_deadline)
                self._erp.warm_up()
            erp = self._erp
        spare = None
        try:
            context = self.task["brief"].split("## Rules")[0].strip()
            spare = await self._spare_context(site)
            attempts = {
                asyncio.create_task(self._spec_attempt(site, "spec", self.contexts[site], context, erp,
                                                       thinking=False, steps=SPEC_STEPS_FAST)): "fast",
                asyncio.create_task(self._spec_attempt(site, "spec2", spare or self.contexts[site], context, erp,
                                                       thinking=True, steps=SPEC_STEPS_THINKING)): "thinking",
            }
            results: list[SpecResult] = []
            pending = set(attempts)
            while pending and self.spec is None:
                done, pending = await asyncio.wait(pending, return_when=asyncio.FIRST_COMPLETED)
                for task in done:
                    if task.cancelled() or task.exception() is not None:
                        error = None if task.cancelled() else task.exception()
                        board.problem("specification", f"{attempts[task]} attempt failed: {type(error).__name__}: "
                                                       f"{str(error)[:160]}")
                        continue
                    result = task.result()
                    results.append(result)
                    if result.current_revision and result.requirements and self.spec is None:
                        self.spec = result
                        self.trace.event("specification", "winner", attempt=attempts[task],
                                         revision=result.current_revision, seconds=result.seconds)
                    else:
                        for problem in result.problems:
                            board.problem("specification", f"{attempts[task]} attempt: {problem}")
            for task in pending:  # the other attempt is no longer needed
                task.cancel()
            if pending:
                await asyncio.gather(*pending, return_exceptions=True)
            await self._close_context(spare)  # its tabs would compete with the ERP workers for the browser
            spare = None
            if self.spec is None:  # neither finished with requirements: keep the most that was read
                self.spec = max(results, key=lambda r: len(r.requirements), default=SpecResult())
            self._adopt_revision(self.spec, site, erp)
            for problem in self.spec.problems:
                board.problem("specification", problem)
            if not self.requirements:
                board.problem("specification", "no requirement read")
            if erp is None:
                return
            self.erp = await erp.collect()
            await self._post_materials(erp_site or "")
        except Exception as error:
            board.problem("specification", f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}")
        finally:
            board.finish("requirement")
            board.finish("material")
            await self._close_context(spare)

    @staticmethod
    async def _close_context(context: BrowserContext | None) -> None:
        if context is not None:
            try:
                await context.close()

async def reselect(requirements: list[EffectiveRequirement], erp: ErpResearch, trace: Trace | None = None,
                   budget: float = RESELECT_SECONDS) -> dict[str, str | None]:
    """
    Choose again once reserves or amendments have resolved the requirements (the ERP stage inspected every hit,
    so no further browsing is needed). A choice the ERP stage's model made that still passes `check_choice` for the
    final requirement stands without another call; the others are asked in parallel within `budget` seconds. A
    requirement whose choice fails or runs out of time gets None and a problem on its research, so its position is
    left out rather than taken for "no material" (no_bid); the choices made by then are kept.
    """
    by_id = {r.requirement_id: r for r in erp.requirements}
    chosen: dict[str, str | None] = {}
    asked: list[str] = []

    async def one(req: EffectiveRequirement) -> None:
        research = by_id.get(req.requirement_id)
        if research is None:
            return
        if research.no_hits and not research.inspected:  # the group is empty: nothing to choose from
            chosen[req.requirement_id] = None
            return
        materials = {n: erp.materials[n] for n in research.inspected if n in erp.materials}
        if (req.stroke is not None and research.selected in materials
                and check_choice(req, research, materials, research.selected) is None):
            chosen[req.requirement_id] = research.selected
            return
        if req.stroke is not None:  # a stroke that was pending in the ERP stage is known now
            research.problems = [p for p in research.problems if "stroke pending" not in p]
        asked.append(req.requirement_id)
        number, problems = await choose_material(req, research, materials, trace)
        research.problems += [p for p in problems if p not in research.problems]
        chosen[req.requirement_id] = number

    started = time.monotonic()
    tasks = [asyncio.create_task(one(r)) for r in requirements]
    if tasks:
        _, pending = await asyncio.wait(tasks, timeout=budget)
        for task in pending:
            task.cancel()
        await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
    for req in requirements:
        research = by_id.get(req.requirement_id)
        if research is not None and req.requirement_id not in chosen:
            research.problems.append(f"{req.requirement_id}: final material choice not made in time")
            chosen[req.requirement_id] = None
    if trace:
        trace.event("choose", "reselect", seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 1), asked=asked, chosen=chosen)
    return chosen

async def reselect(requirements: list[EffectiveRequirement], erp: ErpResearch, trace: Trace | None = None,
                   budget: float = RESELECT_SECONDS) -> dict[str, str | None]:
    """
    Choose again once reserves or amendments have resolved the requirements (the ERP stage inspected every hit,
    so no further browsing is needed). A choice the ERP stage's model made that still passes `check_choice` for the
    final requirement stands without another call; the others are asked in parallel within `budget` seconds. A
    requirement whose choice fails or runs out of time gets None and a problem on its research, so its position is
    left out rather than taken for "no material" (no_bid); the choices made by then are kept.
    """
    by_id = {r.requirement_id: r for r in erp.requirements}
    chosen: dict[str, str | None] = {}
    asked: list[str] = []

    async def one(req: EffectiveRequirement) -> None:
        research = by_id.get(req.requirement_id)
        if research is None:
            return
        if research.no_hits and not research.inspected:  # the group is empty: nothing to choose from
            chosen[req.requirement_id] = None
            return
        materials = {n: erp.materials[n] for n in research.inspected if n in erp.materials}
        if (req.stroke is not None and research.selected in materials
                and check_choice(req, research, materials, research.selected) is None):
            chosen[req.requirement_id] = research.selected
            return
        if req.stroke is not None:  # a stroke that was pending in the ERP stage is known now
            research.problems = [p for p in research.problems if "stroke pending" not in p]
        asked.append(req.requirement_id)
        number, problems = await choose_material(req, research, materials, trace)
        research.problems += [p for p in problems if p not in research.problems]
        chosen[req.requirement_id] = number

    started = time.monotonic()
    tasks = [asyncio.create_task(one(r)) for r in requirements]
    if tasks:
        _, pending = await asyncio.wait(tasks, timeout=budget)
        for task in pending:
            task.cancel()
        await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
    for req in requirements:
        research = by_id.get(req.requirement_id)
        if research is not None and req.requirement_id not in chosen:
            research.problems.append(f"{req.requirement_id}: final material choice not made in time")
            chosen[req.requirement_id] = None
    if trace:
        trace.event("choose", "reselect", seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 1), asked=asked, chosen=chosen)
    return chosen

from site_tools import NO_HITS
from orchestrator import FACT_KINDS, Orchestrator, Plan, plan_research
from research import (ErpResearch, SearchReport, SpecPage, _extract_page, _material_record, _num,
                      _parse_requirement, _read_material, _read_settings, choose_material, contradicted, incomplete,
                      inspection_order,
                      same_revision)
from tracing import Trace
async def choose_material(req: EffectiveRequirement, research: RequirementResearch,
                          materials: dict[str, MaterialRecord], trace: Trace | None = None
                          ) -> tuple[str | None, list[str]]:
    """The model picks the material from the inspected candidates; `evidence.check_choice` validates the exact
    match and status and sends a wrong choice back with the reason."""
    if req.stroke is None:
        return None, [f"{req.requirement_id}: stroke pending ({'; '.join(req.pending)})"]
    if not materials:
        return None, [f"{req.requirement_id}: no material could be inspected"]
    agent = Agent(llm.model(), output_type=MaterialChoice, instructions=CHOOSE_MATERIAL,
                  model_settings=llm.settings(CHOOSE_THINKING, timeout=llm.env_seconds("LLM_CHOOSE_TIMEOUT", 30.0)),
                  retries=3)

    @agent.output_validator
    def _valid(out: MaterialChoice) -> MaterialChoice:
        problem = check_choice(req, research, materials, out.material_number.strip() or None)
        if problem:
            if trace:
                trace.event("choose", "choice_refused", requirement=req.requirement_id, chose=out.material_number,
                            problem=problem)
            raise ModelRetry(problem)
        return out

    listing = "\n".join(_describe(n, r, research) for n, r in materials.items())
    prompt = f"Requirement {req.requirement_id}: {_want(req)}.\nInspected ERP materials:\n{listing}"
    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        choice = (await agent.run(prompt)).output
    except Exception as error:
        return None, [f"{req.requirement_id}: no valid choice ({type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:120]})"]
    if trace:
        trace.event("choose", "material", requirement=req.requirement_id, chose=choice.material_number,
                    why=choice.why, seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 1))
    return choice.material_number.strip() or None, []

"""
The mailbox over plain HTTP (AGENT_MAIL_HTTP, on by default) for the batched mail research (mail_batch).

The webmail renders on the server, so the mail batch needs no browser tab: http_site signs in with the run's
credentials through the site's own form (cookies, consent, retries, re-login), http_read turns each page into the
same kind of text a tab shows. A page request takes 0.1 to 0.3 s instead of a tab's load, settle and walk.

What stays with the model: one call reads the mailbox's start page and names the search field and the folders
(`setup`); the plan's model-chosen queries, the selection of rows and the reading are mail_batch's as before.
Helpers here only send the model's query through the form the model named, page through its result list (next-page
links) and fetch the messages the model picked. Anything that does not work over HTTP (no sign-in, no form, a
redirect) returns None or an error, and mail_batch falls back to the browser tabs.
"""
import asyncio
import os
import re
import time
from urllib.parse import unquote_plus, urljoin, urlparse

from pydantic_ai import Agent, ModelRetry

import httpx2

import llm
import site_tools
from http_site import LINK, NEXT, HttpSite, Page

MAIL_HTTP = os.environ.get("AGENT_MAIL_HTTP", "1") == "1"
START_SECONDS = 30.0  # signing in (about 2 s)
SETUP_TIMEOUT = 30.0  # the setup call (thinking off) answers in a few seconds
MAX_PAGES = 12  # result pages followed per search (20 hits at most, three or more per page)
VIEW_CHARS = 14000  # of the start page shown to the setup call
FRAME = re.compile(r"\[frame [^\]]*\].*?\[/frame\]", re.DOTALL)
CONTROL = re.compile(r"\[(?:button|textbox|checkbox|radio|slider|select|textarea|img)[^\]]*\]")
STOP = re.compile(site_tools.STOP_WORDS, re.IGNORECASE)
_TEXTBOX = re.compile(r'\[textbox "((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*)"')
# "0 messages", "Keine Nachrichten gefunden", "no messages found": the site's own empty-result notice. A help text
# that always shows ("at most 20 hits") is then not a refused search.
NO_HITS = re.compile(r"(?<![\d.,])\b0\s+[^\W\d]+|\b(keine|no)\s+\w+\s+(gefunden|found)\b", re.IGNORECASE)
REFUSED = re.compile(r"zu viele|too many|bitte (genauer|eingrenzen|einschränken)|please (narrow|refine)", re.IGNORECASE)
REQUEST_SECONDS = 4.0  # one page answers in 0.2 to 0.7 s; a stalled request (seen: 12 s) is sent again sooner


def _words(text: str) -> set[str]:
    return {w for w in re.split(r"[^\w]+", text.casefold()) if w}


def strip_frames(text: str) -> str:
    return FRAME.sub(" ", text)


def find_field(page: Page, label: str) -> tuple[int, str] | None:
    """(form number, field name) of the text field the model named: exactly its label, else the one field that
    shares the most words with it (a field labelled after its folder, e.g. "Search in <folder>")."""
    fields = [(n, f) for n, form in enumerate(page.forms, 1) for f in form.fields
              if f.kind in ("text", "search", "") and f.name]
    exact = [(n, f.name) for n, f in fields if f.label.strip() == label.strip()]
    if exact:
        return exact[0]
    want = _words(label)

"""Bench the positions reader thinking on vs off on kept pages: pos_bench.py <trace.jsonl> <reference> [runs]"""
import asyncio
import json
import sys
import time

sys.path.insert(0, "/Users/jonasstenglein/OtherProjects/EHL_Finale/error404ai_ehl_finals/.claude/worktrees/agent-a8b7ef45f5802af58/agent")

import research_tender  # noqa: E402

path, reference = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
runs = int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv) > 3 else 2
kept, views = [], {}
for line in open(path):
    e = json.loads(line)
    if e["kind"] == "nav_done" and e["worker"].endswith(":tender"):
        kept += e["kept"].get("positions", [])
    if e["kind"] == "view" and e.get("http"):
        views[e["url"]] = f"URL: {e['url']}\nTitle: \n\n{e['text']}"
pages = []
for k in kept:
    for url, v in views.items():
        if url.endswith(k.replace("&", "&")) and v not in pages:
            pages.append(v)
text = "\n\n".join(pages)
print(len(pages), "pages", len(text), "chars")


async def main():
    for thinking in (True, False):
        for i in range(runs):
            t = time.monotonic()
            prompt = f"Tender {reference}. Documents:"
            out = await research_tender._read(research_tender.TenderPositions, research_tender.POSITIONS_INSTRUCTIONS,
                                              text, prompt, thinking=thinking)
            got = [(p.position, p.quantity, p.unit, p.requirement) for p in out.positions]
            print("thinking" if thinking else "fast", i, round(time.monotonic() - t, 1), "s", got, flush=True)


asyncio.run(main())

        return records

async def read_positions(text: str, reference: str) -> TenderPositions:
    """
    The positions, thinking on, within POSITIONS_READ_SECONDS in all: in one sandbox run the reader's calls kept
    timing out and retrying from 137 s to the research deadline, so no position reached the bid. After that
    bound, one thinking-off read (short answers, fast) within POSITIONS_FALLBACK_SECONDS.
    """
    prompt = f"Tender {reference}. Documents:"
    try:
        return await asyncio.wait_for(_read(TenderPositions, POSITIONS_INSTRUCTIONS, text, prompt),
                                      POSITIONS_READ_SECONDS)
    except asyncio.TimeoutError:
        print(f"[tender] positions reader still busy after {POSITIONS_READ_SECONDS:g} s; reading once thinking off",
              flush=True)
    return await asyncio.wait_for(_read(TenderPositions, POSITIONS_INSTRUCTIONS, text, prompt, thinking=False),
                                  POSITIONS_FALLBACK_SECONDS)
